见面.components: 见 see (目 eye over 儿 legs) + 面 face (pictograph of a face)

遇到.mnemonic: Walking '辶' along, you bump into a monkey '禺' and arrive '到' together — an encounter.
遇到.components: 遇 meet by chance (辶 walk + 禺 monkey) + 到 arrive (至 + 刂)
遇到.example_zh: 我在路上遇到了老同学。
遇到.example_en: I ran into an old classmate on the way.

太阳.mnemonic: A big '大' extra dot '丶' of sun '日' shining by the hill '阝' — the sun.
太阳.components: 太 very; great (大 big + 丶 dot) + 阳 sun; sunny side (阝 hill + 日 sun)
太阳.example_en: The sun is really strong today.

月亮.mnemonic: A crescent moon '月' shining bright '亮' over a tall roof '亠' — the moon.
月亮.components: 月 moon (pictograph) + 亮 bright (亠 + 口 + 冖 + 几)
月亮.example_en: Tonight's moon is big and round.

云.mnemonic: Two lines '二' of sky with a curl '厶' of vapor drifting below — a cloud.
云.components: 二 two (sky) + 厶 curl of vapor
云.example_en: There are many white clouds in the sky.

刮风.mnemonic: Wind '风' so sharp it scrapes '刮' like a knife '刂' across your tongue '舌'.
刮风.components: 刮 scrape; blow (舌 tongue + 刂 knife) + 风 wind (几 + 㐅)
刮风.example_zh: 外面刮风了，多穿点衣服。
刮风.example_en: It's windy outside, put on more clothes.

树.mnemonic: A wooden '木' trunk paired '对' with branches — a tree.
树.example_en: There are many big trees in the park.

草.mnemonic: Sprouts '艹' popping up early '早' in the morning — grass.
草.example_en: Please don't walk on the grass.

花.mnemonic: A plant '艹' that changes '化' from bud to bloom — a flower; changing money means spending.

春.mnemonic: Three people '三人' basking under the sun '日' — spring has arrived.
春.components: 𡗗 (三 three + 人 person) + 日 sun
春.example_en: Spring has come and the weather is warmer.

夏.mnemonic: A big head '頁' over slow dragging feet '夂' — trudging through summer heat.
夏.components: head (from 頁) + 夂 slow feet
夏.example_en: Summers in Beijing are very hot.

秋.mnemonic: Grain '禾' turning fire '火' red and gold — autumn harvest.

冬.mnemonic: Slow dragging feet '夂' over two drops of ice '⺀' — winter.

季节.mnemonic: A child '子' of the grain '禾' grows through each segment '节' of the year — seasons.
季节.components: 季 season (禾 grain + 子 child) + 节 node; festival (艹 grass + 卩 seal)
季节.example_en: Which season do you like most?

变化.mnemonic: A hand '又' tweaks things '亦', and a standing person '亻' flips upside down '匕' — total change.
变化.components: 变 change (亦 also + 又 hand) + 化 transform (亻 person + 匕 upside-down person)
变化.example_en: This place has changed a lot in recent years.

出现.mnemonic: A sprout pushes out '出' of the pit, and you see '见' jade '王' — it appears!
出现.components: 出 go out (sprout rising from 凵 pit; looks like stacked 山) + 现 appear (王 jade + 见 see)
出现.example_en: A rainbow appeared in the sky.

爬山.mnemonic: Claws '爪' grip the rock as you crawl '爬' up three peaks '山' — hiking!
爬山.components: 爬 climb; crawl (爪 claw + 巴) + 山 mountain (pictograph of three peaks)

动物.mnemonic: Things '物' like an ox '牛' that move '动' with strength '力' — animals.
动物.components: 动 move (云 cloud + 力 strength) + 物 thing (牛 ox + 勿)
动物.example_zh: 我的女儿很喜欢小动物。
动物.example_en: My daughter really likes small animals.

熊猫.mnemonic: A bear '熊' with four paws '灬' that looks like a cat '猫' among sprouts '苗' — panda.
熊猫.components: 熊 bear (能 + 灬 four dots) + 猫 cat (犭 animal + 苗 sprout)

马.mnemonic: The shape '马' is a horse turned sideways: mane at the top, legs and tail sweeping down.
马.components: pictograph of a horse (simplified from 馬)

鸟.mnemonic: A bird '鸟' with a dot eye, hooked beak, and tail sweeping below.
鸟.components: pictograph of a bird (simplified from 鳥)
鸟.example_en: There is a little bird in the tree.

音乐.mnemonic: Stand '立' under the sun '日' and hear sound '音' from drums on a wooden stand '乐' — music.
音乐.components: 音 sound (立 stand + 日 sun) + 乐 music; happy (simplified from 樂, drums on a wooden stand)
音乐.example_en: I listen to music every evening.

游戏.mnemonic: A child '子' swimming '游' in water '氵' and a hand '又' waving a toy spear '戈' — playing games.
游戏.components: 游 swim; roam (氵 water + 斿 banner with 子 child) + 戏 play (又 hand + 戈 spear)
游戏.example_en: The children are playing a game.

节目.mnemonic: Each segment '节' you watch with your eye '目' is one program on TV.
节目.components: 节 segment; festival (艹 + 卩) + 目 eye; item
节目.example_zh: 这个电视节目很有意思。
节目.example_en: This TV program is very interesting.

比赛.mnemonic: Two people side by side '比' race for shells '贝' of prize money '赛' — a competition.
比赛.components: 比 compare (two 匕 people side by side) + 赛 compete (宀 roof + 共-like middle + 贝 shell/money)
比赛.example_en: There is a soccer match tomorrow.

参加.mnemonic: A big '大' person with flowing hair '彡' adds '加' strength '力' and voice '口' — joining in.
参加.components: 参 participate (厶 + 大 big + 彡 hair) + 加 add (力 strength + 口 mouth)

新闻.mnemonic: Freshly axed '斤' new '新' wood, and an ear '耳' at the gate '门' hearing — the news.
新闻.components: 新 new (亲 + 斤 axe) + 闻 hear (门 gate + 耳 ear)
新闻.example_en: Dad watches the news every morning.

声音.mnemonic: A scholar '士' strikes a chime '声' while standing '立' under the sun '日' — a sound rings out.
声音.components: 声 sound (士 + top of a stone chime) + 音 sound (立 stand + 日 sun)
声音.example_en: Please speak a little more quietly.

画.mnemonic: A field '田' sketched inside a frame '凵' with a line '一' on top — a drawing.
画.components: 一 line + 田 field + 凵 frame
画.example_en: The cat she drew is very beautiful.

节日.mnemonic: A special segment '节' of the calendar with a bright sun '日' — a festival day.
节日.components: 节 festival; segment (艹 + 卩) + 日 sun; day
节日.example_zh: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
节日.example_en: Spring Festival is the most important holiday in China.

周末.mnemonic: At the tip '末' of the tree '木' is the end of the week '周' — weekend.
周末.components: 周 week; circuit (冂 + 土 + 口) + 末 end (木 tree with a long top stroke at its tip)
周末.example_zh: 这个周末我们去看电影吧。
周末.example_en: Let's go see a movie this weekend.

祝.mnemonic: An older brother '兄' kneels at the altar '礻' with open mouth '口' — making a wish.
祝.components: 礻 altar + 兄 elder brother (口 mouth + 儿 person)

元.mnemonic: Two strokes '二' on top of legs '儿' — a person's head, the basic unit: one yuan.

角.mnemonic: An ox horn '角' with ridges inside — once small horn coins, a jiao is a tenth of a yuan.
角.example_en: One apple costs five yuan and five jiao.

分.mnemonic: A knife '刀' divides '八' a coin into tiny pieces — fen, the smallest unit.
分.example_zh: 他这次考试得了九十分。
分.example_en: He got ninety points on this test.

碗.mnemonic: A bowl carved from '石' stone, its rim curving round like '宛'.
碗.example_en: I ate two bowls of rice today.

盘子.mnemonic: A '舟' boat-shaped serving dish sitting on a '皿' vessel base: a plate.
盘子.components: 盘 plate (舟 boat + 皿 dish) + 子 noun suffix
盘子.example_en: Please put the plates on the table.

筷子.mnemonic: Two '⺮' bamboo sticks that move '快' quickly to grab food: chopsticks.
筷子.components: 筷 chopstick (⺮ bamboo + 快 quick) + 子 noun suffix

冰箱.mnemonic: A '箱' box where '冫' ice freezes '水' water: the refrigerator.
冰箱.components: 冰 ice (冫 ice + 水 water) + 箱 box (⺮ bamboo + 相 phonetic)
冰箱.example_en: There is still a lot of fruit in the fridge.

厨房.mnemonic: Under a '厂' shelter, a hand '寸' cooks '豆' beans in a '房' room: the kitchen.
厨房.components: 厨 kitchen (厂 shelter + 豆 bean + 寸 hand) + 房 room (户 door + 方)
厨房.example_en: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.

衬衫.mnemonic: '衤' clothing fitted to the '寸' inch, plus '衫' a garment with '彡' stitched lines: a shirt.
衬衫.components: 衬 lining (衤 clothing + 寸 inch) + 衫 garment (衤 clothing + 彡 strokes)
衬衫.example_zh: 他今天穿了一件白衬衫。
衬衫.example_en: He is wearing a white shirt today.

裤子.mnemonic: '衤' clothing that stores your legs like a '库' warehouse: trousers.
裤子.components: 裤 trousers (衤 clothing + 库 storehouse) + 子 noun suffix
裤子.example_en: These trousers are a bit long.

裙子.mnemonic: Elegant '衤' clothing fit for a '君' noble lady: a skirt.
裙子.components: 裙 skirt (衤 clothing + 君 lord) + 子 noun suffix
裙子.example_zh: 她买了一条红色的裙子。

帽子.mnemonic: A '巾' cloth that '冒' covers the top of your head: a hat.
帽子.components: 帽 hat (巾 cloth + 冒 cover/emerge) + 子 noun suffix
帽子.example_en: It's cold outside, put on a hat.

皮鞋.mnemonic: '皮' skin tanned into '革' leather and shaped into '鞋' shoes: leather shoes.
皮鞋.components: 皮 skin, leather + 鞋 shoe (革 leather + 圭 phonetic)
皮鞋.example_zh: 我爸爸每天穿皮鞋上班。
皮鞋.example_en: My dad wears leather shoes to work every day.

伞.mnemonic: Look: a '人' canopy on top, ribs '丷' below, and a '十' handle: an open umbrella.
伞.components: pictograph of an umbrella: 人 canopy + 丷 ribs + 十 shaft
伞.example_en: It's raining, don't forget to bring an umbrella.

包.mnemonic: '勹' wraps around '巳' something inside, like a bag holding its contents.
包.example_en: Your bag is on the chair.

行李箱.mnemonic: A '箱' box for things you carry when you '行' travel, packed with '李' plums: a suitcase.
行李箱.components: 行 travel + 李 plum (木 tree + 子) + 箱 box; 行李 = luggage

护照.mnemonic: A '扌' hand guarding the '户' door, plus '照' a photo ID: the passport protects you abroad.
护照.components: 护 protect (扌 hand + 户 door) + 照 photo, certificate (昭 + 灬 fire)
护照.example_zh: 出国的时候一定要带护照。
护照.example_en: You must bring your passport when you go abroad.

信用卡.mnemonic: A '卡' card you '用' use because the bank '信' trusts your word: a credit card.
信用卡.components: 信 trust (亻 person + 言 words) + 用 use + 卡 card (上 + 下)
信用卡.example_en: Can I use a credit card here?

照相机.mnemonic: A '机' machine that '照' shines light to capture a '相' look: a camera.
照相机.components: 照 shine, photograph + 相 appearance (木 tree + 目 eye) + 机 machine (木 + 几)
照相机.example_zh: 他带着照相机去旅游了。
照相机.example_en: He took his camera on the trip.

照片.mnemonic: Light '照' shines and freezes a thin '片' slice of time: a photo.
照片.components: 照 shine, photograph (昭 + 灬 fire) + 片 slice, piece
照片.example_zh: 这张照片是在北京照的。
照片.example_en: This photo was taken in Beijing.

礼物.mnemonic: A '物' thing, like an '牛' ox, offered at the '礻' altar as a courtesy: a gift.
礼物.components: 礼 courtesy, ritual (礻 spirit + 乚) + 物 thing (牛 ox + 勿)
礼物.example_zh: 这是我送给你的生日礼物。
礼物.example_en: This is the birthday present I'm giving you.

笔记本.mnemonic: A '本' book where your '笔' bamboo brush '记' records notes: a notebook.
笔记本.components: 笔 pen (⺮ bamboo + 毛 hair) + 记 record (讠 speech + 己 self) + 本 book (木 + 一)

灯.mnemonic: A '火' fire hung on a '丁' nail lights up the room: a lamp.
灯.example_en: Please turn off the light before going to bed.

空调.mnemonic: A machine that '调' adjusts the '空' empty air in a cave: an air conditioner.
空调.components: 空 empty, air (穴 cave + 工 work) + 调 adjust (讠 speech + 周)
空调.example_zh: 天气太热了，快开空调吧！
空调.example_en: It's too hot, turn on the air conditioner!

蓝.mnemonic: The '艹' indigo plant you '监' watch over yields blue dye.
蓝.components: 艹 grass/plant + 监 (phonetic, to oversee)
蓝.example_en: The sky is especially blue today.

绿.mnemonic: '纟' silk threads dyed the color of spring leaves: green.
绿.example_en: Spring has come and the trees have all turned green.

打扫.mnemonic: A '扌' hand hits like a hammer '丁', another '扌' hand holds a '彐' broom: cleaning.
打扫.components: 打 hit, do (扌 hand + 丁 nail) + 扫 sweep (扌 hand + 彐 broom-hand)
打扫.example_zh: 我们周末一起打扫房间吧。
打扫.example_en: Let's clean the room together this weekend.

搬.mnemonic: A '扌' hand moves things the way a '般' boat carries cargo.
搬.example_en: He is moving house next month.

放.mnemonic: A hand '攵' sets something down in its '方' place: to put.
放.components: 方 direction, place + 攵 hand action
放.example_en: Where did you put the keys?

拿.mnemonic: A '手' hand '合' closes around something: to take or hold.
拿.components: 合 close, join + 手 hand
拿.example_en: Please hold this book for me.

关.mnemonic: Picture '丷' two bolts sliding across a '天' gate: to close.
关.components: 丷 + 天 (simplified from 關: 門 door + bolt)
关.example_zh: 出门的时候别忘了关门。
关.example_en: Don't forget to close the door when you go out.

换.mnemonic: A '扌' hand swaps one thing for a shinier '奂' one: to change.
换.example_zh: 我想换一件大一点儿的衣服。
换.example_en: I'd like to exchange it for a slightly bigger piece of clothing.

借.mnemonic: A '亻' person borrows something from the '昔' past and must return it.
借.components: 亻 person + 昔 former times (phonetic)
借.example_zh: 我可以借你的笔用一下吗？
借.example_en: Can I borrow your pen for a moment?

用.mnemonic: '用' looks like a sturdy bucket you use every day.
用.components: single pictograph, often explained as a bucket or fence
用.example_en: Do you know how to use this computer?

洗手间.mnemonic: The '间' room behind the '门' door where you '洗' wash your '手' hands: the restroom.
洗手间.components: 洗 wash (氵 water + 先) + 手 hand + 间 room (门 door + 日 sun)
洗手间.example_en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

电梯.mnemonic: A '梯' wooden ladder powered by '电' electricity: the elevator.
电梯.components: 电 electricity (lightning pictograph) + 梯 ladder (木 wood + 弟)

楼.mnemonic: '木' timber stacked up story after story '娄': a building.
楼.example_en: My family lives on the sixth floor.

层.mnemonic: Under a '尸' roof, layers pile up like '云' clouds: floors of a building.
层.example_en: This building has twenty floors in total.

照顾.mnemonic: Shine '照' light on someone and turn your '页' head to watch over them: take care.
照顾.components: 照 shine, look after + 顾 look back (厄 + 页 head)
照顾.example_zh: 姐姐在家照顾生病的妈妈。
照顾.example_en: My older sister is at home taking care of our sick mother.

小心.mnemonic: Keep your '心' heart '小' small and alert: be careful.
小心.example_en: There's ice on the road, be careful!

习惯.mnemonic: '习' practice something until it is '贯' threaded through your '忄' heart: a habit.
习惯.components: 习 practice (simplified from 習 wings) + 惯 accustomed (忄 heart + 贯 string through)
习惯.example_zh: 我已经习惯了这里的天气。
习惯.example_en: I've already gotten used to the weather here.

班.mnemonic: A '刂' knife splits jade '王' between two '王' halves: dividing people into classes.
班.components: 王 jade + 刂 knife + 王 jade
班.example_en: There are thirty students in our class.

年级.mnemonic: Each '年' year you climb one '级' step on the silk '纟' ladder: school grade.
年级.components: 年 year + 级 level (纟 silk + 及 reach)
年级.example_en: My younger brother is in third grade this year.

黑板.mnemonic: A '木' wooden '板' board painted '黑' black like soot over fire.
黑板.components: 黑 black (soot over 灬 fire) + 板 board (木 wood + 反)
黑板.example_zh: 老师在黑板上写了几个字。
黑板.example_en: The teacher wrote a few characters on the blackboard.

作业.mnemonic: A '亻' person '作' doing their '业' work after school: homework.
作业.components: 作 do, make (亻 person + 乍) + 业 work, task

复习.mnemonic: '复' again and again you '习' flap your wings to practice: to review.
复习.components: 复 again, repeat + 习 practice
复习.example_en: You should review well before the exam.

练习.mnemonic: Twisting '纟' silk over and over, you '习' practice the skill: to practice.
练习.components: 练 train (纟 silk + 东) + 习 practice
练习.example_en: I practice speaking Chinese every day.

成绩.mnemonic: What you '成' complete, '绩' spun like silk '纟' into results: your grade.
成绩.components: 成 accomplish + 绩 achievement (纟 silk + 责 duty)
成绩.example_zh: 他这次考试的成绩很好。
成绩.example_en: He got a very good score on this exam.

数学.mnemonic: A hand '攵' counting '数' things while a child '子' learns '学': mathematics.
数学.components: 数 number, count (娄 + 攵 hand) + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子 child)

历史.mnemonic: Under a '厂' cliff, '力' strength passes through time, and a hand holds the '史' record: history.
历史.components: 历 pass through (厂 cliff + 力 strength) + 史 history (hand holding a record)

体育.mnemonic: Training a '亻' person's '本' body to '育' raise a strong child: sports and PE.
体育.components: 体 body (亻 person + 本 root) + 育 raise (𠫓 child + 月 flesh)
体育.example_zh: 我们星期三下午有体育课。
体育.example_en: We have PE class on Wednesday afternoon.

词语.mnemonic: '讠' Speech managed by '司' an official and '吾' my own speech: words and expressions.
词语.components: 词 word (讠 speech + 司 manage) + 语 language (讠 speech + 吾 I)

句子.mnemonic: A '口' mouth '勹' wrapped into one complete thought: a sentence.
句子.components: 句 sentence (勹 wrap + 口 mouth) + 子 noun suffix
句子.example_zh: 请用这个词写一个句子。
句子.example_en: Please write a sentence using this word.

字典.mnemonic: A '典' classic book on a stand listing every '字' character, a child '子' under a '宀' roof.
字典.components: 字 character (宀 roof + 子 child) + 典 classic, book on a stand
字典.example_zh: 不认识的字可以查字典。
字典.example_en: You can look up characters you don't know in a dictionary.

普通话.mnemonic: '话' Speech from the '舌' tongue that '通' passes '普' everywhere: Mandarin.
普通话.components: 普 universal (並 + 日 sun) + 通 pass through (辶 walk + 甬) + 话 speech (讠 + 舌 tongue)
普通话.example_zh: 他的普通话说得非常好。

中文.mnemonic: The '文' writing of the '中' Middle Kingdom, a line through its center: Chinese.
中文.components: 中 middle (line through a box) + 文 writing, culture
中文.example_en: I have studied Chinese for two years.

图书馆.mnemonic: A '馆' hall full of '图' pictures and '书' books: the library.
图书馆.components: 图 picture (囗 enclosure + 冬) + 书 book + 馆 hall (饣 food + 官 official)
图书馆.example_en: I often go to the library to read.

水平.mnemonic: '水' Water always lies '平' flat, a perfect level: standard.
水平.components: 水 water + 平 flat, level
水平.example_zh: 他的汉语水平提高得很快。
水平.example_en: His Chinese level has improved quickly.

教.mnemonic: An elder '耂' guides a '子' child with a '攵' hand: to teach.
教.components: 耂 elder + 子 child + 攵 hand action

讲.mnemonic: '讠' Words drawn up steadily like water from a '井' well: to explain.
讲.example_zh: 爷爷给我讲了一个故事。

明白.mnemonic: '日' Sun plus '月' moon make it bright, and '白' white is clear: to understand.
明白.components: 明 bright (日 sun + 月 moon) + 白 white, clear
明白.example_en: Do you understand what I mean?

清楚.mnemonic: '氵' Water so '青' clear you can see through the '林' woods: clear.
清楚.components: 清 clear (氵 water + 青 blue-green) + 楚 distinct (林 woods + 疋)
清楚.example_en: The teacher explained it very clearly.

了解.mnemonic: Use a '刀' knife to cut apart an '牛' ox's '角' horn and '了' finish: understand fully.
了解.components: 了 finish + 解 untie, explain (角 horn + 刀 knife + 牛 ox)
了解.example_zh: 我想多了解一下中国文化。
了解.example_en: I want to learn more about Chinese culture.

记得.mnemonic: '记' Record it with '讠' words so you '得' get to keep it: remember.
记得.components: 记 record (讠 speech + 己 self) + 得 obtain (彳 step + 㝵)
记得.example_en: Do you still remember his name?

忘记.mnemonic: The '心' heart has '亡' lost what you '记' recorded: forget.
忘记.components: 忘 forget (亡 lost + 心 heart) + 记 record (讠 speech + 己 self)
忘记.example_en: I forgot to bring my keys.

相信.mnemonic: A '亻' person's '言' words seen '相' eye to eye: to trust.
相信.components: 相 mutual (木 tree + 目 eye) + 信 trust (亻 person + 言 words)
相信.example_en: I believe you can definitely do it well.

认为.mnemonic: A '人' person puts it into '讠' words and '为' acts on it: to think.
认为.components: 认 recognize (讠 speech + 人 person) + 为 do, as
认为.example_en: I think this method is very good.

发现.mnemonic: Something '发' sent out suddenly appears '现' as shining '王' jade you '见' see: discover.
发现.components: 发 send out + 现 appear (王 jade + 见 see)
发现.example_zh: 我发现他今天不太高兴。
发现.example_en: I noticed he isn't very happy today.

提高.mnemonic: A '扌' hand lifts something up to a '高' tall tower: to raise.
提高.components: 提 lift (扌 hand + 是) + 高 tall (tower pictograph)
提高.example_zh: 我想提高我的汉语水平。
提高.example_en: I want to improve my Chinese level.

故事.mnemonic: '古' Old '事' affairs retold by hand '攵': a story.
故事.components: 故 old, past (古 ancient + 攵 hand) + 事 matter, affair

文化.mnemonic: '文' Writing that '化' transforms a '亻' person: culture.
文化.components: 文 writing, pattern + 化 change (亻 person + 匕)
文化.example_zh: 我对中国文化很感兴趣。
文化.example_en: I'm very interested in Chinese culture.

办法.mnemonic: Use '力' strength to '办' handle it, following '氵' water's path '去': a method.
办法.components: 办 handle (力 strength + two dots) + 法 method, law (氵 water + 去 go)
办法.example_zh: 别担心，我们一定有办法。
办法.example_en: Don't worry, we'll definitely find a way.

其实.mnemonic: Under the '宀' roof is the '头' real head of the matter: '其实' actually.
其实.components: 其 its, that + 实 real (宀 roof + 头 head)
其实.example_zh: 其实我不太喜欢吃辣的。
其实.example_en: Actually, I don't really like spicy food.

办公室.mnemonic: A '室' room under a '宀' roof where you '办' handle '公' public business: an office.
办公室.components: 办 handle (力 strength) + 公 public (八 + 厶) + 室 room (宀 roof + 至 arrive)
办公室.example_en: The manager is in the office now.

会议.mnemonic: '人' People '会' gather and '议' discuss with '讠' words: a meeting.
会议.components: 会 meet (人 person + 云) + 议 discuss (讠 speech + 义 meaning)
会议.example_zh: 明天上午有一个重要的会议。
会议.example_en: There is an important meeting tomorrow morning.

电子邮件.mnemonic: An '件' item sent by '邮' post through '电' electric wires: email.
电子邮件.components: 电 electric + 子 suffix + 邮 post (由 + 阝 town) + 件 item (亻 person + 牛 ox)
电子邮件.example_zh: 我昨天给你发了一封电子邮件。
电子邮件.example_en: I sent you an email yesterday.

上网.mnemonic: Climb '上' up onto the '网' net, a web of crossed lines: go online.
上网.components: 上 up, go onto + 网 net (冂 frame + crossed lines)
上网.example_zh: 我每天晚上上网看新闻。
上网.example_en: I go online to read the news every evening.

推开.mnemonic: The hand radical 扌 shoves a bird (隹) to make it flee, then 开 swings the door open.
推开.components: 推: 扌 hand + 隹 bird (push); 开: open
推开.example_en: He pushed the door open and walked into the room.

前进.mnemonic: In 前 you step forward on a boat, and 进 shows a bird (隹) walking on the move: onward!
前进.components: 前: forward, front; 进: 辶 walk + 井/隹 phonetic, to enter, advance

退.mnemonic: The walking radical 辶 beside a sun-like 艮 shape: you step backward, away from the sun.
退.components: 辶 walk + 艮 stop/look back (retreat)
退.example_zh: 这件衣服太小了，我想退。
退.example_en: This piece of clothing is too small, I want to return it.

退出.mnemonic: After 退 you retreat, then 出 shows a foot leaving a cup-like boundary: you step out and quit.
退出.components: 退: retreat; 出: go out

追.mnemonic: The walking radical 辶 plus 阜-like 𠂤 shape: feet running after a hill of enemies you pursue.
追.example_en: The puppy is chasing the kitten.

随.mnemonic: The hill radical 阝 with 有 beside a walking 辶 path: you follow along the hill road behind someone.
随.components: 阝 hill + 辶 walk + 有 have (follow)
随.example_en: The child followed Mom to the store.

转.mnemonic: Cart 车 rolls with its wheels, and 专 spins it: the wheel turns around.

跳.mnemonic: The foot radical ⻊ plus 兆, a sign of a million cracks: your feet spring up and jump.
跳.example_en: The kitten jumped onto the table.

按.mnemonic: The hand 扌 pressing down on 安 peaceful: a hand presses a button to keep things calm.

手指.mnemonic: 手 is a hand with fingers spread, and 指 is a hand 扌 pointing with a spoon-like 旨.
手指.components: 手: hand; 指: 扌 hand + 旨 purpose/phonetic

血.mnemonic: A dish 皿 with a single drop 丿 on top: a bowl holding a drop of blood.

心.mnemonic: A drawing of a heart with a bowl shape and three drops beating inside it.
心.example_en: My heart is beating very fast.

伤.mnemonic: The person radical 亻 beside 𠂉-style strokes: a person struck by a blow gets hurt.

受伤.mnemonic: 受 shows a hand passing something to a hand, and 伤 is a person hurt: a person receiving a wound.
受伤.components: 受: receive; 伤: 亻 person + hurt
受伤.example_en: He got injured while playing soccer.

痛.mnemonic: The sickness shell 疒 holds 甬, a tunnel: pain tunnels through the body.

困.mnemonic: A tree 木 locked inside a box 囗: it is trapped and, tired, wants to sleep.
困.example_en: I'm very sleepy today and want to sleep.

死.mnemonic: A bone fragment 歹 beside a person-shaped 匕: a person turns into bones, dead.
死.components: 歹 bone/death + 匕 person changed

去世.mnemonic: 去 means go and 世 means world: someone goes away from the world.
去世.components: 去: go away; 世: world, generation
去世.example_en: His grandfather passed away last year.

生命.mnemonic: 生 is a sprout growing from soil, and 命 is an order given by a mouth: the order of life.
生命.components: 生: sprout, life; 命: 人 + 口 + 卩 command, fate

活.mnemonic: Water 氵 next to 舌 the tongue: a living creature still drinks and tastes.

救.mnemonic: 求 a plea with 攵 a hand holding a stick: someone answers a plea and rescues you.
救.components: 求: seek, beg; 攵 tap/action

毛病.mnemonic: 毛 is a tuft of hair, and 病 is a sickness shell with 丙: little hairy flaws and illnesses.
毛病.components: 毛: hair; 病: 疒 illness + 丙 phonetic
毛病.example_en: There's something wrong with this car.

足球.mnemonic: 足 is a foot, and 球 is a jade-like 王 ball you chase: a ball for feet.
足球.components: 足: foot; 球: 王 jade + 求 phonetic, ball

跳高.mnemonic: 跳 is feet jumping, and 高 is a tall tower: jump up high.
跳高.example_en: He is very good at the high jump.

跳远.mnemonic: 跳 is feet jumping, and 远 is a walking 辶 far away: jump far.
跳远.components: 跳: jump; 远: 辶 walk + 袁 phonetic, far
跳远.example_en: She won first place in the long jump.

武术.mnemonic: 武 stops (止) a spear (戈), and 术 is a skill: the skill of stopping fights.
武术.components: 武: 止 stop + 戈 spear; 术: skill
武术.example_en: He has studied martial arts since he was little.

功夫.mnemonic: 功 is effort (力 strength) at work 工, and 夫 is a man: a man's long effort.
功夫.components: 功: 工 work + 力 strength; 夫: man
功夫.example_en: His kung fu is very good.

训练.mnemonic: 训 is words 讠 that guide a river 川, and 练 is silk 纟 being refined: guided practice.
训练.components: 训: 讠 speech + 川; 练: 纟 silk + 东
训练.example_en: Athletes have to train every day.

教练.mnemonic: 教 is a teacher beating a child (攵), and 练 is silk 纟 refined: the one who refines you.
教练.components: 教: teach; 练: 纟 silk + 东, practice

选手.mnemonic: 选 is a walking 辶 choosing, and 手 is a hand: a chosen hand to compete.
选手.components: 选: 辶 walk + 先, choose; 手: hand, person skilled

队员.mnemonic: 队 is a hill 阝 with people lined up, and 员 has a mouth 口 and shell 贝: a member.
队员.components: 队: 阝 + 人 team; 员: 口 + 贝, member
队员.example_en: He is a member of our team.

对手.mnemonic: 对 is a hand measuring (寸) facing someone, and 手 is a hand: the hand opposite yours.
对手.components: 对: 又 + 寸, facing; 手: hand

球迷.mnemonic: 球 is a ball and 迷 has a walking 辶 and rice 米: lost on the road in love with the ball.
球迷.components: 球: ball; 迷: 辶 + 米, lost, fascinated

世界杯.mnemonic: 世 is generations, 界 is boundaries in a field 田, and 杯 is a wooden 木 cup: a cup for the world.
世界杯.components: 世: world; 界: 田 field + 介, boundary; 杯: 木 wood + 不, cup
世界杯.example_en: The World Cup is held once every four years.

决赛.mnemonic: 决 is water 氵 breaking through a dam, and 赛 has a shell 贝: the final contest for the prize.
决赛.components: 决: 氵 water + 夬, decide; 赛: contest

得分.mnemonic: 得 means to gain on the road (彳), and 分 is a knife 刀 dividing 八: gaining points.
得分.components: 得: gain; 分: 八 + 刀, divide, point
得分.example_en: He scored ten points in the game.

赢.mnemonic: The pieces 亡 口 月 贝 stack in 赢: a mouth-full shell hoard shows you gained the win.
赢.components: 亡, 口, 月, 贝 shell/money, 凡 (win/profit)

输.mnemonic: The cart 车 with 俞 passing along: your cart carries away everything you owned, so you lose.
输.components: 车 vehicle + 俞 phonetic, transport or lose
输.example_en: He lost the game and felt sad.

胜.mnemonic: The flesh 月 radical with 生 life: living strength lets you win.

胜利.mnemonic: 胜 is victory, and 利 is grain 禾 cut by a knife 刂: harvest the win.
胜利.components: 胜: 月 + 生, win; 利: 禾 grain + 刂 knife, profit

金牌.mnemonic: 金 is gold nuggets under a roof, and 牌 is a board 片 plaque: a golden plaque.
金牌.components: 金: gold, metal; 牌: 片 slab + 卑, card, medal

银牌.mnemonic: 银 is metal 钅 that is stern (艮), and 牌 is a plaque: a silver plaque.
银牌.components: 银: 钅 metal + 艮, silver; 牌: plaque

排名.mnemonic: 排 is hands 扌 pushing things into rows, and 名 is a name spoken in the evening: names in order.
排名.components: 排: 扌 hand + 非, arrange; 名: 夕 + 口, name

领先.mnemonic: 领 is a head 页 given a command 令, and 先 shows a person with a foot ahead: head first.
领先.components: 领: 令 order + 页 head; 先: first
领先.example_en: Our team is ahead by two points.

落后.mnemonic: 落 is grass 艹 and water 氵 dropping, and 后 is behind: falling behind.
落后.components: 落: 艹 + 氵 + 各, fall; 后: behind

纪录.mnemonic: 纪 is silk thread 纟 to mark oneself, and 录 is something carved: written down.
纪录.components: 纪: 纟 silk + 己 self; 录: record

全场.mnemonic: 全 is a king 王 under a roof 入, and 场 is earth 土 and sunshine: the entire grounds.
全场.components: 全: whole; 场: 土 earth + 汤-like 昜, field

争.mnemonic: A hand pulling a hook ⺈ and another hand: two hands tug over one thing, so they fight.
争.example_en: They are competing for first place.

争取.mnemonic: 争 is a tug-of-war, and 取 is an ear 耳 caught by a hand 又: fight to take it.
争取.components: 争: compete; 取: 耳 ear + 又 hand, take
争取.example_en: I will strive for this opportunity.

艺术.mnemonic: 艺 is grass 艹 and skill, and 术 is a path with a dot: skill of cultivated craft.
艺术.components: 艺: 艹 + 乙, skill; 术: art, method

美术.mnemonic: 美 is a sheep 羊 and big 大: fine and beautiful, plus 术 for a skill.
美术.components: 美: 羊 + 大, beautiful; 术: skill
美术.example_en: She studies at an art school.

表演.mnemonic: 表 is a robe with clothes outside, and 演 is water 氵 flowing out in a performance.
表演.components: 表: show, outer; 演: 氵 water + 寅, perform
表演.example_en: The children are performing on stage.

演.mnemonic: Water 氵 flows and spreads on 寅, so the story flows out on stage as a performance.
演.example_en: He has acted in many movies.

演出.mnemonic: 演 is performing, and 出 is something leaving a bowl: come out and perform.
演出.components: 演: perform; 出: go out
演出.example_zh: 今晚有演出，我们去看吧！
演出.example_en: There's a performance tonight, let's go see it!

演员.mnemonic: 演 is performing and 员 has a mouth 口 and a shell 贝: a performer for pay.

导演.mnemonic: 导 is a hand 寸 guiding a path 巳, and 演 is performance: the guide of a show.
导演.components: 导: 道 + 寸, lead; 演: perform
导演.example_en: He wants to become a film director.

舞台.mnemonic: 舞 is dancing feet with sleeves, and 台 is a platform: a platform for dance.
舞台.example_en: She stands on the stage singing.

剧场.mnemonic: 剧 is a knife 刂 cutting drama, and 场 is a ground: the ground for dramas.
剧场.components: 剧: drama, 刂 knife; 场: place

话剧.mnemonic: 话 is words 讠 on the tongue 舌, and 剧 is drama: a drama of talking.
话剧.components: 话: 讠 + 舌, speech; 剧: drama
话剧.example_en: Let's go see a stage play.

京剧.mnemonic: 京 is a high city gate, and 剧 is drama: the drama of the capital.
京剧.example_en: Grandpa likes listening to Beijing opera.

乐队.mnemonic: 乐 is a drum with music, and 队 is people in rows: a band.

歌手.mnemonic: 歌 is two 可 mouths singing with 欠 yawning open, and 手 is a hand: a singer.
歌手.components: 歌: 哥 + 欠, song; 手: person

歌声.mnemonic: 歌 is song and 声 is a sound struck on a stone chime: the sound of singing.
歌声.example_en: Your singing voice is really beautiful!

歌迷.mnemonic: 歌 is song, and 迷 is rice 米 on a walking 辶 path, lost in it: song-lover.
歌迷.example_en: Many fans came to see her.

迷.mnemonic: The walking radical 辶 with rice 米 scattered: paths get confusing so you are lost, or crazy about something.

演唱.mnemonic: 演 is performing, and 唱 is mouths 口 singing: sing on stage.
演唱.components: 演: perform; 唱: 口 mouth + 昌 bright

演唱会.mnemonic: 演唱 is singing, and 会 is people gathering under a roof: a singing gathering.
演唱会.components: 演唱: sing on stage; 会: meeting
演唱会.example_en: We're going to see her concert.

录音.mnemonic: 录 is to record, and 音 is a sound from a mouth: record sound.
录音.components: 录: record; 音: 立 + 日, sound
录音.example_en: I want to make a recording.

录.mnemonic: A shape 彐 with water drops falling: pieces carved and set down to record.

欢乐.mnemonic: 欢 is a person yawning with joy 欠, and 乐 is a drum: joy with music.
欢乐.components: 欢: 又 + 欠, joyful; 乐: happy
欢乐.example_en: The children's laughter is very joyful.

乐.mnemonic: A drum on a wooden stand: when the drum plays, people are happy.
乐.components: Pictograph of a drum on a stand

哈哈.mnemonic: Two mouths 口 each with 合: two mouths opening wide laughing.
哈哈.components: 口 mouth + 合 phonetic, repeated
哈哈.example_en: Haha, what you said is so funny!

玩具.mnemonic: 玩 is jade 王 played with, and 具 is hands holding a shell: tools for play.
玩具.components: 玩: 王 jade + 元, play; 具: tool

媒体.mnemonic: 媒 is a woman 女 matchmaking, and 体 is a body 亻本: a body of connection.
媒体.components: 媒: 女 + 某, go-between; 体: 亻 + 本, body
媒体.example_en: The media reported on this matter.

电视剧.mnemonic: 电 is lightning, 视 is seeing, and 剧 is drama: lightning-viewed drama.
电视剧.components: 电: electricity; 视: see; 剧: drama
电视剧.example_en: My mom loves watching TV series.

电视台.mnemonic: 电视 is the screen, and 台 is a platform: a platform of electric sight.
电视台.example_en: This TV station is very large.

电台.mnemonic: 电 is lightning and 台 is a platform: a platform for electric sound.
电台.example_en: I listen to music on the radio.

连续剧.mnemonic: 连 is a cart chain, 续 is silk thread continued, and 剧 is drama: a drama strung on.
连续剧.components: 连: 辶 + 车, connect; 续: 纟 + 卖; 剧: drama
连续剧.example_en: This TV serial has thirty episodes.

影视.mnemonic: 影 is shadow, 视 is seeing: shadows seen on a screen.
影视.example_en: He works at a film and television company.

广播.mnemonic: 广 is a wide roof, and 播 is a hand 扌 sowing seeds: sow sounds widely.
广播.components: 广: wide; 播: 扌 + 番, sow
广播.example_en: I like listening to the radio.

播出.mnemonic: 播 is sowing, and 出 is going out: sow it out on air.
播出.components: 播: sow, broadcast; 出: out
播出.example_zh: 这个节目晚上八点播出。
播出.example_en: This program airs at eight in the evening.

播放.mnemonic: 播 is sowing seeds, and 放 is setting free: set the show free.
播放.components: 播: broadcast; 放: set free

直播.mnemonic: 直 is eye 目 straight, and 播 is sowing: sow it straight to eyes.
直播.example_en: He is livestreaming a video game.

现场.mnemonic: 现 is jade 王 appearing, and 场 is a ground: appearing on the ground.
现场.components: 现: 王 + 见, appear; 场: place
现场.example_en: We watched the game on the spot.

记者.mnemonic: 记 is words 讠 about oneself, and 者 is a person: a person who records words.
记者.components: 记: 讠 + 己; 者: person

报道.mnemonic: 报 is a hand and kneeling person catching a case, and 道 is a road: news along a road.
报道.components: 报: report; 道: 辶 + 首, way
报道.example_en: This news report is in the newspaper.

文章.mnemonic: 文 is crossed lines for writing, and 章 is sound 音 over ten 十: a section of writing.

文学.mnemonic: 文 is writing, and 学 is a child under a roof learning: literary learning.

作品.mnemonic: 作 is a person 亻 making something, and 品 is three mouths 口 of goods: made goods.
作品.components: 作: 亻 + 乍, make; 品: three 口, item

作者.mnemonic: 作 is making and 者 is a person: the one who makes.
作者.example_en: Who is the author of this book?

读者.mnemonic: 读 is words 讠 sold 卖, and 者 is a person: a person who reads.
读者.components: 读: 讠 + 卖, read; 者: person
读者.example_en: Readers like this book a lot.

标题.mnemonic: 标 is a wood 木 sign, and 题 is a head 页 of a page: the head sign.

读音.mnemonic: 读 is words 讠 sold 卖, spoken; 音 is a sound: how it is voiced.

音节.mnemonic: 音 is sound, 节 is a bamboo 竹 joint: sounds sectioned like bamboo.

语言.mnemonic: 语 is speech 讠 and 言 is a mouth with words: spoken language.

对话.mnemonic: 对 is facing a person, 话 is a tongue 舌 giving words 讠: talk facing each other.

流利.mnemonic: 流 is water 氵 flowing, 利 is a knife 刂 sharp on grain 禾: smooth and sharp.

日报.mnemonic: 日 is a sun-day, 报 is a hand 扌 and a kneeling person: daily reports.

小说.mnemonic: 小 is tiny, 说 is speaking 讠: small talk that grows into a novel.

广告.mnemonic: 广 is a wide shelter, 告 is a mouth 口 with an ox 牛 telling: a wide announcement.
广告.example_en: There are many ads on TV.

影片.mnemonic: 影 is a scene 景 with shadow 彡; 片 is a flat slice: a film strip.

图片.mnemonic: 图 is a picture within a frame 囗; 片 is a flat piece: a flat image.

相机.mnemonic: 相 is a tree 木 seen by an eye 目; 机 is wooden 木 machinery: an eye machine.

照相.mnemonic: 照 is sun 日 and fire 灬 lighting up; 相 is a look: capture a look.

画儿.mnemonic: 画 shows a brush framing a field; 儿 is a small person suffix: a little painting.
画儿.example_en: There is a painting on the wall.

网.mnemonic: A pictograph of crossed ropes knotted together to make a fishing net.

网站.mnemonic: 网 is a net, 站 is a person standing 立 at a spot: a standing place on the net.

信息.mnemonic: 信 is a person keeping words, 息 is a heart 心 breathing from the self 自: news.

短信.mnemonic: 短 is an arrow 矢 beside a bean 豆, short; 信 is a message.
短信.example_en: I sent you a text message.

信.mnemonic: A person 亻 whose words 言 are true is trusted; a letter carries them.

信号.mnemonic: 信 is a message and 号 is a mouth 口 calling out: a calling message.

开机.mnemonic: 开 opens a gate, 机 is a wooden machine: open the machine.
开机.example_en: Turn on the device first, then open the software.

关机.mnemonic: 关 is a gate with a bolt, 机 is a machine: bolt the machine shut.
关机.example_en: Please turn it off before sleeping.

打印.mnemonic: 打 is a hand 扌 striking, 印 is a hand pressing a kneeling person: press on paper.

计算机.mnemonic: 计 counts with ten 十 words 讠, 算 is bamboo 竹 beads counting, 机 is a machine.

计算机.example_en: I do my homework on a computer.

通知.mnemonic: 通 is a road passing through; 知 is an arrow 矢 hitting the mouth 口: let people know.
通知.components: 通 pass through + 知 know
通知.example_zh: 老师通知我们明天考试。
通知.example_en: The teacher notified us of tomorrow's exam.

定期.mnemonic: A roof 宀 over a firmly set 疋 foot, plus 期 moon cycle: fixed in place, returning on schedule.
定期.components: 定 settle (宀 roof + 正 upright) + 期 period

期.mnemonic: A basket 其 beside the moon 月: each full moon marks one period.
期.example_en: This issue of the magazine is very interesting.

整天.mnemonic: Whole 整 plus 天, the sky above: the entire span of sky-time.

当初.mnemonic: 衤 cloth meets a knife 刀 at the very start of tailoring, and 当 pins it to that moment.
当初.components: 当 at that time + 初 beginning (衤 clothing + 刀 knife)
当初.example_en: At first I didn't want to study Chinese.

从前.mnemonic: Two people 从 follow each other, while 前 points ahead: those who walked before us.
从前.components: 从 from (two people) + 前 front/before
从前.example_en: Once upon a time there was a little girl.

曾经.mnemonic: Threads 纟 run through (经) layered 曾 time: layers of experience already lived.
曾经.components: 曾 once + 经 pass through (纟 thread)
曾经.example_en: I have been to Beijing before.

早已.mnemonic: Sun 日 up on the 十 mark is early 早, and curled 已 shows the thing finished.
早已.components: 早 early (日 sun + 十) + 已 already

已.mnemonic: A snake curled up with its coil complete: finished and already done.
已.components: 已, a single curled-up form meaning already

至今.mnemonic: An arrow landing on the ground 至, plus 今 now: it has arrived at the present.
至今.example_zh: 至今我还记得他的名字。
至今.example_en: I still remember his name to this day.

以来.mnemonic: A person's tool 以 and wheat 来 coming toward you: everything arriving up to now.
以来.example_zh: 毕业以来，我一直在工作。
以来.example_en: Since graduating, I have been working.

自从.mnemonic: A nose 自 pointing at yourself and two people 从 following: counting from yourself onward.
自从.example_zh: 自从搬家以后，我很开心。
自从.example_en: Since moving house, I have been happy.

直到.mnemonic: A straight 直 line of sight reaching 到 an arrival point: keep going straight till you get there.
直到.components: 直 straight + 到 arrive (至 + 刂)

始终.mnemonic: A woman 女 with a mouth 台 starts things; 终 threads 纟 come to winter's end: start to finish.
始终.components: 始 begin (女 + 台) + 终 end (纟 thread + 冬 winter)
始终.example_en: He never gave up from start to finish.

从来.mnemonic: Following 从 two people, with wheat 来 always coming: it has come this way all along.

本来.mnemonic: A tree 木 with its root marked 本, plus 来 coming: how things were at the root.
本来.components: 本 root (木 tree + 一 mark) + 来 come
本来.example_zh: 我本来想去，可是太累了。
本来.example_en: I originally wanted to go, but I was too tired.

提前.mnemonic: A hand 扌 lifts (提) the front 前: you pull the schedule forward.
提前.components: 提 lift (扌 hand) + 前 front
提前.example_en: The meeting was moved up by an hour.

及时.mnemonic: A hand 又 catching a person 亻 (及) while the sun's temple 寸 marks time 时: caught just in time.
及时.components: 及 reach + 时 time (日 sun + 寸 inch)
及时.example_en: The doctor arrived just in time.

立刻.mnemonic: A person standing 立 and a knife 刂 cutting: do it at the cut of a blade.
立刻.components: 立 stand + 刻 moment (亥 + 刂 knife)

连忙.mnemonic: Vehicle 车 joined by 辶 road, plus a heart 忄 in a bustle: hastily dashing along.
连忙.components: 连 link (车 cart + 辶 walk) + 忙 busy (忄 heart + 亡)

赶紧.mnemonic: Feet 走 chasing (赶) with silk threads 糸 pulled tight 紧: rush, nothing slack.
赶紧.components: 赶 chase (走 run + 干) + 紧 tight
赶紧.example_zh: 天要下雨了，赶紧回家吧。
赶紧.example_en: It's going to rain, so hurry home.

赶快.mnemonic: Run 走 to chase, with a heart 忄 that is 快 quick: hurry fast.
赶快.components: 赶 chase + 快 fast (忄 heart + 夬)
赶快.example_en: Eat quickly, we're going to be late.

总.mnemonic: A heart 心 beneath a gathering 丷: gather everything together into a total.
总.components: 总 total (heart 心 below, 丷 on top)

往往.mnemonic: Each 往 has a step 彳 and a host 主: step after step along the same path, again and again.
往往.components: 往 go toward (彳 step + 主), doubled
往往.example_en: On weekends he is usually at home.

通常.mnemonic: A path 辶 runs through (通) with a cloth 巾 hung under a roof-like 尚: the ordinary way.
通常.components: 通 pass through (辶 + 甬) + 常 usual (尚 + 巾 cloth)
通常.example_en: I usually get up at seven.

不断.mnemonic: No 不 plus 断, an axe 斤 cutting threads: threads never cut.
不断.components: 不 not + 断 cut off (斤 axe)

连续.mnemonic: Linked cart 连 and silk thread 纟 sold 卖: a chain linked one after another.
连续.components: 连 link (车 + 辶) + 续 continue (纟 thread + 卖)
连续.example_en: It rained for three days in a row.

持续.mnemonic: A hand 扌 at a temple 寺 holds on, and thread 续 continues: hold the line going.
持续.components: 持 hold (扌 hand + 寺) + 续 continue (纟 thread)
持续.example_en: The heavy rain lasted all night.

继续.mnemonic: Threads 纟 re-linked in 继 and 续: a cord spliced so it keeps going.
继续.components: 继 continue (纟 thread) + 续 continue (纟 thread)

反复.mnemonic: A hand over a cliff 反 flips back; 复 shows a foot going again: back and forth repeatedly.
反复.components: 反 reverse (厂 + 又 hand) + 复 repeat (夂 foot)
反复.example_en: I looked at it three times over.

慢慢.mnemonic: A heart 忄 sprawling out 曼: a stretched-out heart takes its time.
慢慢.components: 慢 slow (忄 heart + 曼), doubled

好好.mnemonic: A woman 女 with a child 子 is good; doubled, it means do it properly.
好好.components: 好 good (女 woman + 子 child), doubled

更加.mnemonic: Strength 力 added to a mouth 口 in 加, atop 更 more: stacking on even more.
更加.components: 更 even more + 加 add (力 power + 口 mouth)
更加.example_en: Today is even colder than yesterday.

极了.mnemonic: A tree 木 with a hand pushing at the limit 及, then 了 done: pushed to the extreme.
极了.components: 极 extreme (木 + 及 reach) + 了 finished

相当.mnemonic: A tree 木 faces an eye 目 in 相: eye to eye, matched equally in size; 当 equals.
相当.components: 相 mutual (木 + 目) + 当 match

简直.mnemonic: Bamboo 竹 slips in 简 beside a straight 直 line: it is straight-out, plain and simple.
简直.components: 简 simple (竹 bamboo + 间) + 直 straight

数量.mnemonic: A counting hand in 数 beside a 量 measure with sun 日 over 里: counting what you measure.
数量.components: 数 number (米 + 女 + 攵) + 量 measure
数量.example_en: The number of students is large.

比例.mnemonic: Two spoons side by side 比 and a person 亻 lined up with 列: items compared in a row.
比例.components: 比 compare + 例 example (亻 person + 列 row)
比例.example_en: The ratio of men to women is one to one.

程度.mnemonic: Grain 禾 measured in 程, and a yard 度 stick: how far up the scale.
程度.components: 程 measure (禾 grain + 呈) + 度 degree
程度.example_en: His level of Chinese is high.

范围.mnemonic: A bamboo 竹 mold 范 surrounded by a box 囗: a fenced-off area.
范围.components: 范 pattern (艹 + 氾) + 围 enclose (囗 box)
范围.example_en: The scope of this problem is very broad.

面积.mnemonic: A face 面 and grain 禾 stacked up in 积: the grain covers the surface.
面积.components: 面 surface + 积 accumulate (禾 grain + 只)

将近.mnemonic: A general's 将 hand and an axe 斤 approaching 近: about to arrive.
将近.components: 将 about to + 近 near (斤 axe + 辶)
将近.example_en: I waited for nearly an hour.

大约.mnemonic: A big 大 person with silk 纟 binding 约: roughly tied in, an approximate size.
大约.components: 大 big + 约 about (纟 thread + 勺)

左右.mnemonic: Left hand 左 with a tool 工 and right hand 右 with a mouth 口: both sides, so around.
左右.components: 左 left (工) + 右 right (口)
左右.example_en: He is around thirty years old.

至少.mnemonic: An arrow landing 至 on a tiny 少 amount: at the very minimum.
至少.example_en: I need to sleep at least eight hours.

足够.mnemonic: A foot 足 and many 多 in 够: enough that many feet are fed.

整整.mnemonic: A hand tapping 攵 bundle 束 in the correct 正 way: a complete, full amount.

顿.mnemonic: A head 页 bent after a bundle 屯: a pause, a bow, a sit-down meal.

束.mnemonic: A tree 木 tied around with a band 口: a tied bunch.

架.mnemonic: A tree 木 with added 加 pieces: a wooden frame that holds something up.

支.mnemonic: A hand 又 holding a branch 十: a stick propped up to support.

整体.mnemonic: Whole 整 and body 体 (亻 person + 本 root): the whole body, not just parts.

全面.components: 全 whole (入 + 王) + 面 side/face

完整.mnemonic: A roof 宀 over 元 in 完 is finished; 整 is whole: finished and unbroken.
完整.components: 完 finish (宀 roof + 元) + 整 whole

一切.mnemonic: One 一 plus a knife 刀 cutting 七: slicing through one after another covers everything.
一切.components: 一 one + 切 cut (七 + 刀)

各.mnemonic: Feet 夂 coming toward a mouth 口 at the door: each one arrives separately.
各.example_en: The food of each country is different.

各位.mnemonic: Each 各 person 亻 standing at a place 立: each person present.
各位.components: 各 each + 位 position (亻 person + 立 stand)

各种.mnemonic: Each 各 sort of grain 禾 in 种: every variety of seed.
各种.components: 各 each + 种 kind (禾 grain + 中)
各种.example_en: The shop has all kinds of fruit.

各自.mnemonic: Each 各 one pointing to their own nose 自: everyone for themselves.

某.mnemonic: A tree 木 sweet 甘 on top: some unnamed tree, an unspecified one.

任何.mnemonic: A person 亻 who bears a burden 壬 in 任, and 何 what: what-so-ever.
任何.components: 任 bear (亻 + 壬) + 何 what (亻 + 可)

双方.mnemonic: Two birds 双 bound together and a square 方 direction: two sides at once.
双方.components: 双 pair (又 + 又) + 方 side

对方.mnemonic: A hand 又 measuring in 对 faces the 方 direction: the one across from you.

类.mnemonic: Rice 米 sorted over a big 大 pile: grains grouped into kinds.

并.mnemonic: Two 丷 items lined up on a shared base: standing side by side, and also.

并.example_en: He is not tall at all.

并且.mnemonic: Side by side 并 and moreover 且 a stack of layers: one thing piled on another.

并且.example_en: He can speak Chinese, and speaks it very well.

不仅.mnemonic: Not 不 only 仅 (亻 person with 又 hand): more than just one person's hand-ful.
不仅.components: 不 not + 仅 only (亻 person + 又)
不仅.example_en: He is not only smart but also hardworking.

不光.mnemonic: Not 不 just light 光 (fire shining on a person): not just the glow, there's more.

另外.mnemonic: A mouth 口 and a knife 力 split in 另, with 外 outside evening 夕: something split off, outside.

因此.mnemonic: A person boxed 囗 in 因 (大 big inside): a cause, and 此 this: because of this.
因此.components: 因 cause (囗 + 大) + 此 this
因此.example_en: He was sick, therefore he didn't come.

由于.mnemonic: Reason 由 and 于 at: the reason it's at this point.
由于.example_en: Because of rain, the match was canceled.

由.mnemonic: A field 田 with a line coming out the top: something sprouting from the field, origin.
由.components: 田 field with a stem on top
由.example_en: This matter is decided by him.

要是.mnemonic: Want 要 and be 是 (sun 日 over right 正): if it were so.
要是.example_en: If it rains, I won't go.

一方面.mnemonic: One 一 side 方 of the face 面: one side of the picture.
一方面.components: 一 one + 方 side + 面 aspect
一方面.example_zh: 一方面我想去，另一方面我没时间。
一方面.example_en: On the one hand I want to go, on the other hand I have no time.

另一方面.mnemonic: Other 另 one 一 side 方 of the face 面: flip to the other side.
另一方面.components: 另 other + 一方面 one aspect
另一方面.example_en: On the other hand, he also works very hard.

其次.mnemonic: A basket 其 and a yawn 次 (冫 + 欠): the second place in line.
其次.components: 其 that + 次 next (冫 + 欠)
其次.example_en: First wash your hands, then eat.

首先.mnemonic: A head 首 and a person 先 stepping forward: the head of the line goes first.
首先.components: 首 head + 先 first (土 + 儿)
首先.example_en: First of all, I want to thank everyone.

确实.mnemonic: Stone 石 in 确 and a roof 宀 with a hand in 实: solid as stone, genuinely so.
确实.components: 确 certain (石 stone + 角) + 实 real (宀 roof)

果然.mnemonic: Fruit 果 on a tree and fire 灬 beneath 然: the fruit ripens just as expected.
果然.components: 果 fruit + 然 so (肰 + 灬 fire)

到底.mnemonic: Arrival 到 down at the bottom 底 beneath a roof 广: at the very bottom of it.
到底.components: 到 arrive (至 + 刂) + 底 bottom (广 + 氐)
到底.example_en: What on earth do you want to eat?

反正.mnemonic: A cliff 厂 with a hand 反 flipping and an upright 正: flip it either way, it stays right.

难道.mnemonic: Hard 难 and a path 道 with a head 首 on 辶: is the road really so hard?
难道.components: 难 difficult (又 + 隹 bird) + 道 road (辶 + 首)
难道.example_en: Could it be that you don't know?

千万.mnemonic: A thousand 千 and ten thousand 万: a mountain of numbers urging you to be sure.
千万.components: 千 thousand + 万 ten thousand
千万.example_en: Be sure not to forget your keys.

恐怕.mnemonic: A heart 心 under 巩 and a white 白 heart 忄 in 怕: a heart gone pale with worry.
恐怕.components: 恐 fear (巩 + 心 heart) + 怕 afraid (忄 + 白)

大概.mnemonic: A tree 木 measured by 既 in 概, with big 大: a big-picture outline.
大概.components: 大 big + 概 general (木 + 既)
大概.example_en: There are roughly a hundred people.

就是.mnemonic: Capital 京 added to the mere 尤 in 就, plus 是: that's the very thing.

只是.mnemonic: A mouth 口 below 八 in 只, with 是 being: nothing more than that.
只是.components: 只 only (口 + 八) + 是 is

只有.mnemonic: Only 只 (a mouth under two strokes) and have 有 (a hand over the moon): only this exists.
只有.components: 只 only + 有 have (又 hand + 月)

只好.mnemonic: Only 只 and good 好 (woman with child): the only good choice left.
只好.example_en: The car broke down, so I had no choice but to walk.

不得不.mnemonic: No 不 getting 得 around no 不: a double negative that leaves only one road.
不得不.components: 不 not + 得 get + 不 not
不得不.example_en: I have to get up earlier.

门口.example_en: He's waiting for you at the door.

床.mnemonic: A 木 wooden frame under a 广 roof-like cover: a bed.

家里.mnemonic: The 家 home under a roof, 里 means inside: in the home.
家里.components: 家 home (宀 roof + 豕 pig) + 里 inside (田 field + 土 earth)

在家.mnemonic: 在 locates one at a 土 earth place, and 家 is the roof with pig: being at home.
在家.components: 在 at (才 + 土 earth) + 家 home (宀 roof + 豕 pig)

回家.mnemonic: 回 shows a square circling back, and 家 is the roof home: circle back home.
回家.components: 回 return (a square within a square) + 家 home (宀 roof + 豕 pig)
回家.example_en: I go home at five o'clock.

楼上.mnemonic: 楼 is a 木 wooden building and 上 puts a mark above the line: upstairs.
楼上.components: 楼 building (木 wood + 娄) + 上 above

楼下.mnemonic: 楼 is a tall wooden build, 下 has a mark below the line: downstairs.
楼下.components: 楼 building (木 wood + 娄) + 下 below

大学.mnemonic: 大 big plus 学, where a 子 child under a roof learns: big school.
大学.components: 大 big + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 roof + 子 child)

大学生.mnemonic: A 大 big school's 学 learner with 生 growing sprout: a college student.
大学生.components: 大 big + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子) + 生 born/grow

小学.mnemonic: 小 small with 学 a child 子 under a roof: primary school.
小学.components: 小 small + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 roof + 子 child)
小学.example_en: He started primary school at six.

小学生.mnemonic: 小 small, 学 learning child, 生 sprout growing: a young pupil.
小学生.components: 小 small + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子) + 生 born/grow
小学生.example_zh: 小学生每天早上去学校。
小学生.example_en: Primary school pupils go to school every morning.

中学.mnemonic: 中 shows an arrow through the middle of a box, and 学 is school: a middle school.
中学.components: 中 middle (口 with a line through) + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子)
中学.example_en: My younger brother studies in middle school.

中学生.mnemonic: 中 mid-level, 学 learner, 生 growing: a middle school student.
中学生.components: 中 middle + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子) + 生 born/grow
中学生.example_en: She is a middle school student.

学院.mnemonic: 学 learning plus 院 courtyard with a 阝 mound: a college courtyard.
学院.components: 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子) + 院 courtyard (阝 mound + 完)
学院.example_en: He studies at a music academy.

教学楼.mnemonic: 教 is a hand with a stick teaching a 子 child; 楼 is the wooden building.
教学楼.components: 教 teach (孝 + 攵 tap) + 学 study + 楼 building (木 wood + 娄)
教学楼.example_en: The classroom building is next to the library.

男生.mnemonic: 男 has 田 field and 力 strength, and 生 is a sprout growing: a young man.
男生.components: 男 male (田 field + 力 strength) + 生 born/student
男生.example_en: There are ten boys in the class.

女生.mnemonic: 女 kneeling figure with 生 sprout growing: a young woman.

上学.mnemonic: 上 up goes to the 学 school where a child 子 under a roof studies.
上学.components: 上 up/go to + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 roof + 子 child)
上学.example_en: We go to school at eight.

放学.mnemonic: 放 sends away with a tap 攵, and 学 school is over: dismissed from school.
放学.components: 放 release (方 + 攵 tap) + 学 study (⺍ + 冖 + 子)
放学.example_en: What time does school let out?

学.mnemonic: A 子 child under a 冖 roof with hands above: learning.
学.components: ⺍ hands + 冖 roof + 子 child

课本.mnemonic: 课 is words 讠 with fruit 果 to produce, 本 is a 木 root with a base mark: a textbook.
课本.components: 课 lesson (讠 speech + 果 fruit) + 本 root/book (木 tree + 一 mark)

课文.mnemonic: 课 lesson with 文 text: the written part of a lesson.
课文.components: 课 lesson (讠 speech + 果 fruit) + 文 text
课文.example_en: We're learning a new text today.

上课.mnemonic: 上 go up to class where 课 words 讠 bear fruit 果.
上课.components: 上 attend + 课 lesson (讠 speech + 果 fruit)

下课.mnemonic: 下 below ends the 课 lesson: class is down.
下课.components: 下 finish/down + 课 lesson (讠 speech + 果 fruit)
下课.example_en: Class is over, let's go eat.

考.mnemonic: An old person 耂 bent over, crossing marks on a test: taking an exam.

读书.mnemonic: 读 is speech 讠 and 卖 selling words, 书 is a book: reading aloud from a book.
读书.components: 读 read (讠 speech + 卖) + 书 book
读书.example_en: He likes reading in the library.

听写.mnemonic: 听 has a 口 mouth and a 斤 axe-like listener, 写 puts a roof 冖 over a pen: listen and write.
听写.components: 听 listen (口 mouth + 斤) + 写 write (冖 cover + 与)

书包.mnemonic: 书 books go into a 包 wrapped pouch: a bag for books.
书包.components: 书 book + 包 wrap (勹 + 巳)

本子.mnemonic: 本 has a 木 tree root marked with a line, and 子 is small: a bound notebook.
本子.components: 本 root/volume (木 tree + 一 mark) + 子 suffix

知识.mnemonic: 知 is an arrow 矢 hitting the 口 mouth to say what you know; 识 is words 讠 to recognize.
知识.components: 知 know (矢 arrow + 口 mouth) + 识 recognize (讠 speech + 只)

汉字.mnemonic: 汉 has water 氵 for the Han river, and 字 has a 子 child under a roof 宀: characters raised at home.
汉字.components: 汉 Han (氵 water + 又) + 字 character (宀 roof + 子 child)

外语.mnemonic: 外 is evening 夕 with divination 卜 outside, and 语 is words 讠: outside language.
外语.components: 外 outside (夕 evening + 卜) + 语 language (讠 speech + 吾)
外语.example_en: How many foreign languages can you speak?

话.mnemonic: Words 讠 with a 舌 tongue: speech is spoken by the tongue.

说.mnemonic: Words 讠 pour out of a 兑 mouth: to speak.

工人.mnemonic: 工 looks like a carpenter's square, and 人 is a person: a worker.
工人.components: 工 work (carpenter's square) + 人 person

下班.mnemonic: 下 ends the 班 shift split with a knife 刂 between two jade 王s.
下班.components: 下 finish + 班 shift (王 + 刂 + 王)
下班.example_en: What time do you get off work?

开会.mnemonic: 开 opens a door 门, 会 gathers people 人 under a roof-like 云: a meeting.
开会.components: 开 open (门 gate + 开) + 会 meet (人 + 云)
开会.example_en: We have a meeting in the afternoon.

放假.mnemonic: 放 sends off, 假 shows a person 亻 borrowing time: sending off work for a holiday.
放假.components: 放 release (方 + 攵) + 假 holiday (亻 person + 叚)

事.mnemonic: A hand holding a brush on a 一 rod: busy with a matter.
事.components: 一 + 口 + 事's hand with a vertical stroke (a hand holding a tool)
事.example_en: Come to me if anything comes up.

干.mnemonic: A forked stick standing upright, a tool that does the work.

手.mnemonic: It looks like a palm with fingers spread out.
手.components: pictograph of a hand with fingers

身上.mnemonic: 身 is a pregnant body, 上 puts a mark above: on the body.
身上.example_en: He has a lot of money on him.

病.mnemonic: Illness radical 疒 over 丙: a person lying sick on a bed.

病人.mnemonic: 病 is a sick figure lying on a bed, and 人 is a person: a patient.
病人.components: 病 illness (疒 sickness + 丙) + 人 person
病人.example_en: There are many patients in the hospital.

看病.mnemonic: 看 is a 手 hand shading the 目 eye, and 病 is the sickness: looking at illness.
看病.components: 看 look (手 hand + 目 eye) + 病 illness (疒 + 丙)
看病.example_en: I'm going to see a doctor tomorrow.

起.mnemonic: 走 walk with 己 oneself: you rise and move.
起.example_en: What time do you get up?

睡.mnemonic: A 目 eye with 垂 drooping: eyelids falling to sleep.
睡.example_en: I go to sleep at ten.

找到.mnemonic: 找 is a 手 hand with a 戈 weapon to search, 到 arrives with a 刂 knife: the search arrives.
找到.components: 找 search (扌 hand + 戈 spear) + 到 arrive (至 + 刂)

电.mnemonic: A rain 雨 cloud with a lightning line through it: electricity.

电话.mnemonic: 电 electricity plus 话 words, 讠 and a 舌 tongue: voices through current.
电话.components: 电 electricity (雨 top + 乚) + 话 words (讠 speech + 舌 tongue)

电视机.mnemonic: 电 power, 视 seeing with the 见 eye, 机 wooden 木 machine: a TV set.
电视机.components: 电 electricity + 视 view (礻 + 见) + 机 machine (木 wood + 几)

网上.mnemonic: 网 looks like a fishing net with crosshatch lines, 上 means on top: on the web.
网上.components: 网 net (pictograph of a net) + 上 above

网友.mnemonic: 网 is a net connecting 友 friends, drawn as hand 又 clasping hand ナ.
网友.components: 网 net + 友 friend (ナ hand + 又 hand)

电影院.mnemonic: 电 and 影 shadows with 景, in a 院 courtyard: a house of shadow pictures.
电影院.components: 电 electricity + 影 shadow (景 + 彡) + 院 courtyard (阝 + 完)
电影院.example_en: We're going to the cinema to watch a movie.

车.mnemonic: It looks like a cart seen from above, with an axle and two wheels.
车.components: pictograph of a cart with axle and wheels

汽车.mnemonic: 汽 steam 氵 rising makes the 车 cart move: a motor car.
汽车.components: 汽 steam (氵 water + 气 air) + 车 vehicle

火车.mnemonic: 火 flames power a 车 cart: a train.
火车.example_en: What time does the train arrive?

飞.mnemonic: It looks like a bird's wings sweeping upward.

开车.mnemonic: 开 opens up, then 车 cart goes: to start the vehicle.
开车.components: 开 open (门 gate) + 车 vehicle
开车.example_en: He drives to work every day.

打车.mnemonic: 打 is a 扌 hand striking, a hand waves 车 to stop: hail a cab.
打车.components: 打 hit (扌 hand + 丁) + 车 vehicle
打车.example_en: Let's take a taxi to the airport.

上车.mnemonic: 上 up onto the 车 cart: climbing aboard.

下车.mnemonic: 下 down off the 车 cart: stepping off.

车票.mnemonic: 车 vehicle plus 票, a slip with fire-like 示: a travel ticket.
车票.components: 车 vehicle + 票 ticket (西 + 示)

机票.mnemonic: 机 with a 木 machine and 几, and 票 ticket: a flight ticket.
机票.components: 机 machine (木 wood + 几) + 票 ticket (西 + 示)

车站.mnemonic: 车 vehicles stop at 站 where a person 立 stands and 占 holds a spot.
车站.components: 车 vehicle + 站 stand (立 stand + 占 occupy)
车站.example_en: The station is very close to here.

坐下.mnemonic: 坐 two people sitting on earth 土, 下 puts them down: sit down.
坐下.components: 坐 sit (two 人 people + 土 earth) + 下 down

车上.mnemonic: 车 vehicle and 上 on top: aboard.
车上.example_en: There are many people on the bus.

地点.mnemonic: 地 is 土 earth and 也, 点 is a dot with fire 灬 under 占: a spot on the ground.
地点.components: 地 ground (土 earth + 也) + 点 point (占 + 灬 fire)

马路.mnemonic: 马 horse beside 路, a 足 foot path with each 各: a road horses travel.
马路.components: 马 horse + 路 road (足 foot + 各)

路口.mnemonic: 路 is a path, 口 is an opening mouth: where roads open.
路口.components: 路 road (足 foot + 各) + 口 mouth/opening

路上.mnemonic: 路 road with 上 on top: along the way.
路上.components: 路 road (足 foot + 各) + 上 above

国.mnemonic: A 玉 jade inside a 囗 enclosure: a treasure within borders.

国外.mnemonic: 国 country with 外 evening and divination outside: beyond borders.
国外.components: 国 country (囗 + 玉) + 外 outside (夕 + 卜)

外国.mnemonic: 外 outside, 国 a jade 玉 in a border 囗: another land.
外国.components: 外 outside (夕 evening + 卜) + 国 country (囗 + 玉)

前.mnemonic: A foot-like 止 shape above a boat 舟 and knife: stepping forward.
前.example_en: The school is in front of the station.

后.mnemonic: A person 𠂉 with a mouth 口 at the back, giving orders from behind.

左.mnemonic: A 工 tool held in the left hand 𠂇.

右.mnemonic: A 口 mouth to eat with the right hand 𠂇.
右.example_en: The bank is on the right.

上边.mnemonic: 上 above, 边 walks 辶 along the edge: top side.
上边.components: 上 above + 边 side (辶 walk + 力)
上边.example_en: The book is on top of the table.

下边.mnemonic: 下 below, 边 walks 辶 along the edge: bottom side.
下边.components: 下 below + 边 side (辶 walk + 力)
下边.example_en: The cat is under the table.

直.mnemonic: A straight vertical line drops through an eye (目) to check that a bar is perfectly straight.
直.components: 十 ten + 目 eye (with a hook/base stroke)

齐.mnemonic: Like a row of neat tiles standing level on a flat base, everything lines up evenly.
齐.components: Single character; top 文-like cap over evenly spaced legs (traditional 齊 = rows of grain)

整齐.mnemonic: Each part lines up evenly, so the tidy whole looks complete: 整 'whole' plus 齐 'even' means neat.
整齐.components: 整 whole, orderly + 齐 even, level

标准.mnemonic: A tree-marked post (木 in 标) sets the level, and 准 'allow' makes it the standard to measure by.
标准.components: 标 木 wood + 示 sign (marker); 准 冫 ice + 隹 bird (permit, accurate)

规范.mnemonic: A measuring tool (夫 + 见 in 规) and a grass-topped (艹) pattern 范 combine to set the norm.
规范.components: 规 夫 man + 见 see (rule, compass); 范 艹 grass + 氾 (model, pattern)
规范.example_en: Please write the homework according to the standard.

合格.mnemonic: Parts fit together (合) and reach the grid-like frame (格) of a set standard, so you pass.
合格.components: 合 fit together; 格 木 wood + 各 each (grid, standard)

合理.mnemonic: What fits together (合) with the veins of jade-like logic (理) is reasonable.
合理.components: 合 fit, match + 理 reason, order (王 jade + 里 inside)

完美.mnemonic: A roof (宀) shelters the whole; add a sheep-with-big (美) beauty and nothing is missing: perfect.
完美.components: 完 宀 roof + 元 origin (complete); 美 beautiful

完善.mnemonic: Under a roof (宀) all is complete, and 善 'good' polishes it until nothing lacks.
完善.components: 完 complete + 善 good, kind
完善.example_en: We need to improve this method.

精彩.mnemonic: Fine rice (米 in 精) and bright colorful strokes (彩) paint a wonderful show.
精彩.components: 精 米 rice + 青 green/pure (refined); 彩 colors

伟大.mnemonic: A person (亻) next to a stretched-out big (大) figure towers as great.
伟大.components: 伟 亻person + 韦 (sound, rare/extraordinary); 大 big

美.mnemonic: A sheep (羊) grown big (大) is a handsome sight, hence beautiful.
美.example_en: The scenery here is really beautiful!

美好.mnemonic: Beautiful (美) plus a woman with a child (好) gives a lovely, fine picture.
美好.components: 美 beautiful + 好 good (女 woman + 子 child)

美丽.mnemonic: Beautiful (美) and a pair of lovely paired deer-horns (丽) shine together.
美丽.components: 美 beautiful + 丽 pretty (paired deer-horn shape)

生动.mnemonic: A sprout (生) that keeps moving (动) is full of life, so it feels vivid.
生动.components: 生 life, sprout + 动 move (云 cloud + 力 strength)

深刻.mnemonic: Water (氵) in a deep hole plus a knife (刂) carving leaves a deep, lasting mark.
深刻.components: 深 氵water + 罙 deep; 刻 亥 + 刂 knife (carve)
深刻.example_zh: 这件事给我留下了深刻的印象。
深刻.example_en: This matter left a deep impression on me.

深.mnemonic: Water (氵) that sinks down into a dark hole is deep.

可靠.mnemonic: Something you can (可) lean on (靠) like a solid wall is reliable.
可靠.components: 可 can + 靠 lean on (告 tell + 非 not)

先进.mnemonic: Feet going ahead (先) and moving forward (进) mark the leading, advanced.
先进.components: 先 first + 进 advance (辶 walk + 井 well/ 讲)
先进.example_en: This is a very advanced machine.

明确.mnemonic: Sun and moon (明) together light things up, and 确 (stone + firm) pins them down clearly.
明确.components: 明 日 sun + 月 moon (bright); 确 石 stone + 角 (firm, sure)

明显.mnemonic: Bright (明) sun-light makes the visible (显) shine out as obvious.
明显.components: 明 bright + 显 日 sun + 业 (to show)

显然.mnemonic: Something shown in the sun (显) with a fire-like (灬) air is plain to see.
显然.components: 显 show, visible + 然 so, -ly (肉 + 犬 + 灬 fire)
显然.example_en: Obviously, he does not want to go.

显得.mnemonic: The sun reveals (显) what you gain (得), so you come across as something.
显得.components: 显 show + 得 get, obtain

看起来.mnemonic: A hand over the eye (看) as things rise (起) and come (来) to view: it looks like.
看起来.components: 看 see (手 hand + 目 eye); 起 rise; 来 come

看上去.mnemonic: A hand over the eye (看) looking up (上) and going (去) outward: it appears.
看上去.components: 看 look; 上 up; 去 go
看上去.example_zh: 这个苹果看上去很好吃。

表面.mnemonic: Clothes (衣 in 表) on the outside and a face (面) show only the surface.
表面.components: 表 outside, show (衣 clothes variant); 面 face, side
表面.example_en: The surface of the table is very clean.

表明.mnemonic: Show on the outside (表) so everything is bright (明) and clear: to make clear.
表明.components: 表 show + 明 bright, clear
表明.example_en: The result shows he was right.

具体.mnemonic: Hands holding goods (具) and a body (体) give something solid and concrete.
具体.components: 具 tool (hands holding a shell/item); 体 亻person + 本 root (body)
具体.example_en: Please be a bit more specific.

复杂.mnemonic: Clothes (衤) layered again and again (复) with mixed-up (杂) bits become complicated.
复杂.components: 复 repeat, again; 杂 mixed (九 + 木 in old form)

困难.mnemonic: A tree (木) boxed in (囗) cannot grow, and a bird (隹) struggling makes things hard.
困难.components: 困 囗 enclosure + 木 tree; 难 又 + 隹 bird (hard)
困难.example_en: Learning Chinese is a bit difficult.

难度.mnemonic: How hard (难) it is, measured on a scale (度) of difficulty.
难度.components: 难 hard + 度 degree, measure
难度.example_en: The difficulty of this question is high.

麻烦.mnemonic: Hemp (麻) tangles and a head burning (烦: 火 + 页) with worry make trouble.
麻烦.components: 麻 hemp; 烦 火 fire + 页 head (vexed)

变为.mnemonic: Changing (变) into something, shown by a fixed shape (为), means to become.
变为.components: 变 change; 为 become, act as

转变.mnemonic: A cart (车 in 转) that turns around brings a change (变).
转变.components: 转 车 vehicle + 专 (turn); 变 change

化.mnemonic: A person (亻) beside an upside-down person (匕) is changing into someone else.

现代化.mnemonic: Now-time (现代) plus the changing-form 化 means turning into modern.
现代化.components: 现 now, appear; 代 era; 化 -ize
现代化.example_en: The country is moving toward modernization.

发展.mnemonic: Letting loose (发) and spreading out (展) lets things grow and develop.
发展.components: 发 emit, send out; 展 unfold, spread
发展.example_en: This city is developing very fast.

发达.mnemonic: Sending out (发) and reaching everywhere (达) marks a developed place.
发达.components: 发 emit; 达 reach (辶 walk + 大 big... )

进步.mnemonic: Advancing (进) one step (步) at a time is progress.
进步.components: 进 advance; 步 step (止 foot + 少)
进步.example_en: Your Chinese has improved a lot.

进展.mnemonic: Moving forward (进) while spreading out (展) shows how work is going.

进一步.mnemonic: Advance (进) by one (一) more step (步): further.
进一步.components: 进 advance + 一 one + 步 step

改进.mnemonic: Fix and change (改) while moving forward (进) means to improve.
改进.components: 改 change (己 + 攵 tap); 进 advance
改进.example_en: We need to improve our work methods.

改造.mnemonic: Change (改) and make (造) anew rebuilds something.
改造.components: 改 change + 造 make (辶 walk + 告)
改造.example_zh: 他们改造了这座老房子。

修改.mnemonic: Mend (修) and change (改) the text: to revise.
修改.components: 修 repair (亻 + 攸 + 彡); 改 change
修改.example_en: Please help me revise this article.

调整.mnemonic: Words (讠) in tune (周) and bundled neatly (整) tune things to fit: to adjust.
调整.components: 调 讠speech + 周 all round; 整 whole, in order
调整.example_en: We need to adjust the time.

形成.mnemonic: A shape (形: 开 + 彡) completes (成) into being: to form.
形成.components: 形 shape + 成 become, complete
形成.example_en: Good habits take time to form.

成长.mnemonic: Becoming (成) long (长), as a child gets taller, is growing up.
成长.components: 成 become + 长 long, grow

生长.mnemonic: A sprout (生) that lengthens (长) is a plant growing.
生长.components: 生 life, sprout + 长 grow

增加.mnemonic: Earth piled up (土 in 增) and strength added (加) means increase.
增加.components: 增 土 earth + 曾 (add to); 加 add (力 power + 口 mouth)
增加.example_en: The number of students has increased.

增长.mnemonic: More earth heaped up (增) and growing long (长) shows growth.

上升.mnemonic: Up (上) and rising like a measure lifting (升) shows going up.

升.mnemonic: A sun-like measuring cup (斗 shape) lifts upward, so to rise.
升.components: Single character; originally a scoop/measure raised up
升.example_en: The sun rises in the east.

加快.mnemonic: Adding (加) a heart (忄 in 快) of speed: to speed up.
加快.components: 加 add + 快 fast (忄 heart + 夬)

加强.mnemonic: Add (加) a bow (弓 in 强) of strength to make stronger.
加强.components: 加 add + 强 strong (弓 bow + 虽)
加强.example_en: We need to strengthen our studies.

补充.mnemonic: Patching clothes (衤 in 补) and filling up (充) means to supplement.
补充.components: 补 衤 clothes + 卜; 充 fill
补充.example_zh: 你还有什么要补充的吗？
补充.example_en: Do you have anything to add?

安排.mnemonic: A woman under a roof (安) with hand (扌) setting things in rows (排): to arrange.

否定.mnemonic: Not (否: 不 + 口) and fixed (定): to negate.
