打开.mnemonic: 打 is a hand 扌 striking a nail 丁; 开 shows a gate bar lifted, swinging open.

帮.mnemonic: Cloth 巾 under 邦 (country): a nation gives its cloth to support others, so help.

玩儿.mnemonic: 玩 has jade 王 you fidget with beside 元; 儿 is a small child skipping about.
玩儿.components: 玩 play (王 jade + 元) + 儿 suffix

唱.mnemonic: A mouth 口 next to 昌 (twin suns, bright): bright sounds from the mouth are singing.

歌.mnemonic: Two 可 (can) piled up beside 欠 (open mouth): a wide-open mouth pours out song.
歌.components: 哥 elder brother/sound + 欠 yawning mouth

打球.mnemonic: 打 is a hand 扌 whacking a nail 丁; 球 has jade 王 for a round ball you seek.
打球.example_en: Let's go play ball this afternoon.

球.mnemonic: The jade 王 radical hints at something smooth and round, and 求 seeks it.

开玩笑.mnemonic: 开 opens a gate, 玩 plays with jade, 笑 has bamboo 竹 bending over a laughing 夭.
开玩笑.components: 开 open + 玩 play + 笑 laugh
开玩笑.example_zh: 我只是开玩笑，你别生气。
开玩笑.example_en: I'm just joking, don't be angry.

动.mnemonic: 力 strength paired with 云 (cloud): power pushing a cloud sets it moving.

动作.mnemonic: 动 is strength moving a cloud; 作 is a person 亻 doing 乍 something suddenly.

打.mnemonic: A hand 扌 strikes a nail 丁, the classic image of hitting.

得到.mnemonic: 得 has a step 彳 toward a hand 寸 grabbing a coin 见-like prize; 到 confirms arrival.

行.mnemonic: 行 pictures a crossroad, a path you can walk, so it is okay to go ahead.
行.components: 彳 left step + 亍 right step
行.example_en: Is it OK to go tomorrow?

没有.mnemonic: 没 has water 氵 over a hand-like 殳, sinking out of sight; 有 means possess, negated.

不大.mnemonic: 不 is a seed beneath a sky line; 大 is a person with arms stretched wide.

不用.mnemonic: 不 blocks like a barrier; 用 is a tool in use: no need to use it.

不对.mnemonic: 不 is no; 对 has a hand 寸 answering correctly beside 又, so not right.
不对.example_en: What you said is not right.

是不是.mnemonic: 是 has the sun 日 straight over 正 correct; 不 negates; so is it or isn't it.
是不是.components: 是 be + 不 not + 是 be

最好.mnemonic: 最 has a sun 日 over a taken 取 prize: the top pick; 好 is woman 女 with child 子.
最好.example_en: You had better sleep a bit earlier.

一点儿.mnemonic: 一 is a single stroke; 点 has fire 灬 under 占 giving dots; 儿 is a little person.
一点儿.components: 一 one + 点 dot + 儿 suffix
一点儿.example_en: I can speak a little Chinese.

常.mnemonic: 巾 cloth under 尚 (esteem): a cloth always worn becomes common and frequent.
常.example_en: He often goes to the library.

常常.mnemonic: Doubling 常 repeats the cloth 巾 in everyday wear, stressing how often.
常常.example_zh: 我常常和朋友一起吃饭。

有时.mnemonic: 有 is a hand holding meat 月; 时 is the sun 日 with a measuring hand 寸 for a moment.
有时.example_en: I sometimes take the subway to work.

有时候.mnemonic: 有 owns; 时 is sun 日 and 寸 measure; 候 is a person 亻 waiting at an arrow 矢 mark.
有时候.components: 有 have + 时 time + 候 moment

上次.mnemonic: 上 puts a mark above the line, earlier; 次 has 冫 ice-cold 欠 yawning, the previous turn.
上次.example_en: Where did you go last time?

下次.mnemonic: 下 puts a mark below the line, coming later; 次 counts the occasion.
下次.example_en: Next time I'll treat you to a meal.

最后.mnemonic: 最 is the sun 日 over a taken prize 取, the extreme; 后 sits behind everyone.
最后.example_en: In the end he came after all.

还有.mnemonic: 还 has a walking 辶 returning to 不; 有 is a hand holding meat, adding more.
还有.example_en: There is also an apple on the table.

一块儿.mnemonic: 一 is one; 块 is soil 土 clumped as a piece 夬; 儿 is a small person: stay as one lump.
一块儿.components: 一 one + 块 piece + 儿 suffix

正.mnemonic: 一 line atop 止 (stop foot): a foot planted firmly on a straight line is correct.
正.example_en: He is just reading a book now.

间.mnemonic: A door 门 with the sun 日 shining through a gap shows a room or space between.

页.mnemonic: 页 shows a big head with a line 一 on top and face below, like a book leaf shown to you.
页.components: 一 + 自-like face + 人 legs

一下儿.mnemonic: 一 is one; 下 puts a mark below; 儿 is a small person: just one quick go.
一下儿.components: 一 one + 下 down/time + 儿 suffix

爱人.mnemonic: 爱 has a heart 心 under a covering 爫 and 友 friend; 人 is a striding person.

太太.mnemonic: 太 is 大 big with a dot 丶 added, repeated twice for the respected lady of the house.

大人.mnemonic: 大 is a person with arms spread wide; 人 is a person: a big, grown person.

主人.mnemonic: 主 is a lamp flame 丶 on a stand 王; 人 is a person who tends it, the host.
主人.example_en: The host asked the guests to sit down.

好人.mnemonic: 好 is a woman 女 with her child 子, kind; 人 is a person.

坏人.mnemonic: 坏 has earth 土 beside 不 (not): ground gone not good; 人 is a person.
坏人.components: 坏 bad (土 earth + 不 not) + 人 person
坏人.example_zh: 电影里的坏人被抓住了。
坏人.example_en: The bad guy in the movie was caught.

老朋友.mnemonic: 老 is a bent old person with a cane; 朋 is two moons 月月 side by side; 友 two hands joined.
老朋友.components: 老 old + 朋 friend + 友 friend

交朋友.mnemonic: 交 shows legs crossing; 朋 two 月 companions; 友 two hands clasped.
交朋友.components: 交 make/cross + 朋 friend + 友 friend
交朋友.example_en: I want to make a lot of friends.

人们.mnemonic: 人 is a walking person; 们 adds 亻 plus 门 door, marking plural groups at a door.
人们.components: 人 person + 们 plural suffix

有人.mnemonic: 有 is a hand holding meat 月; 人 is a person: there exists a person.
有人.components: 有 have/there is + 人 person
有人.example_en: There is someone outside the door.

咱.mnemonic: 口 mouth beside 自 self: a mouth speaking of ourselves together, you and me.

咱们.mnemonic: 咱 is mouth 口 plus self 自; 们 is 亻 person with 门 door as plural marker.
咱们.example_en: Let's go see a movie together.

它们.mnemonic: 它 has a roof 宀 over a snake-like creature; 们 pluralizes it.

青年.mnemonic: 青 is fresh green growth over a moon 月; 年 is a person carrying grain through harvest years.

少年.mnemonic: 少 is 小 small with a bit chipped off; 年 counts years: someone with few years.

青少年.mnemonic: 青 fresh green, 少 few years, 年 years: green young years strung together.
青少年.components: 青 young + 少 young + 年 year

老年.mnemonic: 老 is a hunched old person leaning on a cane; 年 is the years.
老年.example_zh: 爷爷现在已经是老年了。
老年.example_en: Grandpa is already in old age now.

中年.mnemonic: 中 is a line piercing the middle of a box; 年 is years: the middle years.
中年.example_zh: 他今年四十五岁，是中年人。
中年.example_en: He is forty-five this year, a middle-aged man.

长大.mnemonic: 长 looks like long hair streaming down; 大 is a person stretching arms wide.
长大.example_en: The children will grow up soon.

小时候.mnemonic: 小 is a small figure with two dots; 时 is a sun 日 and measure 寸; 候 is a waiting person.
小时候.components: 小 small + 时 time + 候 moment
小时候.example_en: When I was little, I lived in the countryside.

从小.mnemonic: 从 is two people 人 following each other; 小 is small: following since small.
从小.example_en: He has liked drawing since he was little.

一生.mnemonic: 一 is a single stroke; 生 is a sprout 屮 rising from the earth 土: one whole life.

出生.mnemonic: 出 is a plant sprouting outward; 生 is a sprout growing from the earth.

生.mnemonic: A sprout shoots up from the ground 土, a picture of new life being born.
生.components: 屮 sprout + 土 ground-like base
生.example_en: She gave birth to a daughter.

日子.mnemonic: 日 is the sun's square face; 子 is a child: the sun's children, one after another, are days.
日子.components: 日 sun/day + 子 noun suffix

生活.mnemonic: 生 is a sprout of life; 活 has water 氵 beside 舌 tongue, living things that drink and talk.
生活.example_en: I have lived in Beijing for five years.

家庭.mnemonic: 家 has a roof 宀 over a pig 豕; 庭 has a shelter 广 over a courtyard.

家长.mnemonic: 家 is a roof over a pig; 长 is long hair of an elder: the one who leads the home.
家长.example_en: The teacher asked the parents to come to school.

全家.mnemonic: 全 has 人 under 王: everything under one roof of 工; 家 is a roof over a pig.

姓名.mnemonic: 姓 has woman 女 and birth 生, the clan; 名 has evening 夕 and mouth 口 calling out.
姓名.components: 姓 surname + 名 given name
姓名.example_en: Please write down your full name.

名.mnemonic: In the dark of evening 夕 you must call out with your mouth 口 to give your name.

名称.mnemonic: 名 is evening 夕 plus mouth 口; 称 has grain 禾 on a scale 尔, weighed and labeled.
名称.example_en: What is the name of this shop?

名单.mnemonic: 名 is a mouth calling at dusk; 单 is a single sheet, pictured as a flat tally.
名单.example_en: Your name is on the list.

称.mnemonic: 禾 grain is weighed on a scale 尔 held up in the hand: to weigh and to name.

叫作.mnemonic: 叫 is a mouth 口 calling 丩 aloud; 作 is a person 亻 doing 乍 something, so named.
叫作.example_en: This kind of flower is called a rose.

来自.mnemonic: 来 is wheat arriving toward you; 自 is a nose pointing to oneself, the origin.
来自.example_en: I come from the United States.

爱情.mnemonic: 爱 is a heart 心 receiving friendship; 情 has heart 忄 beside green 青, fresh feeling.

样子.mnemonic: 样 has wood 木 beside 羊 sheep, a model shape; 子 is a noun suffix.

班长.mnemonic: 班 has two jades 王 split by a knife 刂; 长 is long-haired elder: the class leader.

队长.mnemonic: 队 has a hill 阝 and a person 人 in line; 长 is the elder who leads.
队长.example_en: The team captain took us to the match.

组长.mnemonic: 组 has silk thread 纟 and 且 stacked: threads bound together; 长 is the leader.
组长.example_en: The group leader isn't here today.

市长.mnemonic: 市 is a cloth 巾 flag over a market stall; 长 is the head of the town.
市长.example_en: The mayor is in a meeting.

院长.mnemonic: 院 has a hill 阝 and 完 complete, a walled compound; 长 is the head of it.
院长.example_en: The director asked everyone to sit down.

画家.mnemonic: 画 is a picture within a frame; 家 is a roof over a pig, here a professional expert.

作家.mnemonic: 作 is a person 亻 doing 乍; 家 under a roof marks one who makes a living at it.

科学家.mnemonic: 科 has grain 禾 measured by a dou 斗; 学 is a child under a roof; 家 is a specialist.
科学家.components: 科 science + 学 study + 家 specialist
科学家.example_en: He wants to become a scientist.

明星.mnemonic: 明 puts the sun 日 beside the moon 月, bright; 星 is a sun 日 with 生 sparks: a star.

商人.mnemonic: 商 has a mouth 口 and a stand 冏 at a stall; 人 is the person selling.

教师.mnemonic: 教 has a child 孝 and a tapping stick 攵; 师 is a cloth 巾 flag for a master.
教师.example_en: She is a middle school teacher.

顾客.mnemonic: 顾 has a head 页 turning back to look; 客 is someone 各 beneath a roof 宀 as a guest.
顾客.components: 顾 look after + 客 guest
顾客.example_en: The customer wants to buy a piece of clothing.

头.mnemonic: The two dots 丷 above 大 show a big round head sitting on a body.

眼.mnemonic: 目 is an eye turned sideways; 艮 stares stubbornly, a fixed gaze.

嘴.mnemonic: A mouth 口 beside 此 (this) with a horn 角: a pointed mouth or beak.
嘴.example_en: He has a piece of candy in his mouth.

全身.mnemonic: 全 has 人 under 王, whole; 身 pictures a pregnant torso with a belly bulge.
全身.example_en: After running, my whole body is covered in sweat.

背.mnemonic: 北 shows two people back to back, with 月 flesh below: the back, and carrying on it.
背.example_en: He carries a big bag on his back.

举手.mnemonic: 举 raises things with hands under a cover; 手 shows a hand with fingers spread.
举手.example_en: Please raise your hand if you have a question.

点头.mnemonic: 点 has fire dots 灬 under 占; 头 is the head, dipping to nod.

笑话.mnemonic: 笑 has bamboo 竹 bending over a laughing 夭; 话 is speech 讠 and tongue 舌.
笑话.example_zh: 他讲了一个很好笑的笑话。
笑话.example_en: He told a very funny joke.

笑话儿.mnemonic: 笑 is bamboo bending as someone laughs; 话 is words; 儿 is a friendly suffix.
笑话儿.components: 笑 laugh + 话 talk + 儿 suffix

难受.mnemonic: 难 has a bird 隹 and 又 stuck in trouble; 受 shows hands passing something to you.
难受.example_en: My stomach feels a bit unwell.

药店.mnemonic: 药 has grass 艹 for herbs; 店 is a shop 广 with 占 stock on display.

药片.mnemonic: 药 has grass 艹 and 约; 片 is half of a log 木, a flat slice.

药水.mnemonic: 药 is herbs 艹 pressed to remedy; 水 shows flowing streams of water.
药水.example_en: You need to drink this bottle of medicine for three days.

西医.mnemonic: 西 is a bird in its nest at sunset; 医 has a box 匚 holding arrows 矢 for healing.
西医.example_en: He is a Western medicine doctor.

中医.mnemonic: 中 pierces the middle of a box; 医 is a box 匚 with an arrow 矢 and tools.
中医.example_en: Grandma likes to see a traditional Chinese doctor.

住院.mnemonic: 住 is a person 亻 staying put by 主; 院 is a hill 阝 compound 完.
住院.example_en: He is sick and has to stay in hospital.

出院.mnemonic: 出 is something sprouting outward; 院 is a walled compound 阝 完, the hospital.
出院.example_en: Mom can leave the hospital tomorrow.

安全.mnemonic: 安 shows a woman 女 under a roof 宀, calm; 全 is everything under one roof.

平安.mnemonic: 平 is a flat balanced line with dots on both sides; 安 is a woman safe under a roof.

白色.mnemonic: 白 is a sun 日 with a ray on top, shining white; 色 is a person 刀-like over 巴.
白色.example_zh: 她穿着一件白色的衬衫。
白色.example_en: She is wearing a white shirt.

黑色.mnemonic: 黑 has fire 灬 under a window 里-like soot: a chimney blackened by flame.

红色.mnemonic: 红 has silk thread 纟 beside 工, dyed red; 色 means color.

黄.mnemonic: A field 田 under a bundle 共-like top: ripe grain fields glow yellow.
黄.example_en: In autumn the leaves turn yellow.

黄色.mnemonic: 黄 is a golden-field yellow; 色 means color.

蓝色.mnemonic: 蓝 has grass 艹 over 监, the indigo dye plant; 色 means color.

绿色.mnemonic: 绿 has silk thread 纟 and 录; dyed thread in grass tones; 色 means color.

亮.mnemonic: A lid 亠 over a mouth 口 and a cover 冖 with a person 儿: a lit-up hall, bright.
亮.components: 亠 + 口 + 冖 + 几
亮.example_en: It is very bright in the room.

多云.mnemonic: 多 stacks two evenings 夕 for many; 云 looks like a drifting cloud.

晴天.mnemonic: 晴 has the sun 日 beside green 青, clear sky; 天 is a person 大 under the heaven line 一.

阴天.mnemonic: 阴 has a hill 阝 beside moon 月, shade; 天 is the sky above a person.

意见.mnemonic: A sound (音) from the heart (心) comes out as an opinion, and what you see (见) becomes your complaint.
意见.components: 意 intention (音 sound + 心 heart) + 见 to see
意见.example_en: I have an objection to this method.

角度.mnemonic: A horn (角) pokes out at an angle, and you measure it with a ruler's degrees (度).
角度.components: 角 horn/corner + 度 degree, measure
角度.example_zh: 你可以从另一个角度想一想。
角度.example_en: You can think about it from another angle.

好像.mnemonic: A good (好) image (像) of something makes it seem like the real thing.
好像.components: 好 good (女 woman + 子 child) + 像 likeness (亻 person + 象 elephant)

也许.mnemonic: It is also (也) allowed (许), so maybe, perhaps.
也许.components: 也 also + 许 to permit (讠 speech + 午 noon)

不一定.mnemonic: Not (不) one (一) fixed (定) outcome under the roof (宀), so not necessarily.
不一定.components: 不 not + 一 one + 定 fixed (宀 roof + 正 correct)
不一定.example_en: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

差不多.mnemonic: Differing (差) not (不) by many (多), two moons stacked, so nearly the same.
差不多.components: 差 differ + 不 not + 多 many (two 夕 evenings stacked)
差不多.example_en: We two are about the same height.

该.mnemonic: Words (讠) spoken at the end of a pact (亥) tell you it should be your turn.
该.example_en: Now it's your turn to sing.

能够.mnemonic: Able (能) enough (够) to do it: a bear-like strength with plenty (多) inside a cave-like frame.
能够.components: 能 able + 够 enough (句 sentence + 多 many)
能够.example_en: Can you get home by yourself?

不要.mnemonic: Not (不) wanting (要): a firm stop sign to refuse something.
不要.components: 不 not + 要 to want (西 cover + 女 woman)

不行.mnemonic: Not (不) able to walk (行): the road is blocked, so no way.
不行.components: 不 not + 行 to walk/be okay (crossroads shape)
不行.example_en: Doing it this way won't work.

请求.mnemonic: Words (讠) asked for with a begging (求) tone become a request.
请求.components: 请 to ask (讠 speech + 青 green) + 求 to seek
请求.example_en: He asked the teacher for help.

求.mnemonic: A fur coat reaching out with strokes, like a hand grabbing: you reach out to ask for something.
求.components: Single pictographic character; resembles a fur robe, used for seeking
求.example_en: I beg you to do me a favor.

答应.mnemonic: Answering (答) with bamboo (⺮) cover and replying (应) under a shelter means you agree.
答应.components: 答 answer (⺮ bamboo + 合 join) + 应 respond (广 shelter + 心 heart)
答应.example_en: Mom promised to take me to the park.

商量.mnemonic: Trade (商) and measure (量) a matter together by talking it over.
商量.components: 商 commerce + 量 to measure

讨论.mnemonic: Speech (讠) measured (寸 inch) and sorted into logical order (仑) forms a discussion.
讨论.components: 讨 discuss (讠 speech + 寸 inch) + 论 discuss (讠 speech + 仑 order)
讨论.example_zh: 我们在讨论明天的计划。

懂得.mnemonic: A heart (忄) that grasps what it gets (得) truly understands.
懂得.components: 懂 understand (忄 heart + 董) + 得 to get

听说.mnemonic: Listen (听) with an ear and then say (说): you hear it said.
听说.components: 听 listen (口 mouth + 斤) + 说 say (讠 speech + 兑)
听说.example_en: I hear that you are going to Beijing.

想到.mnemonic: The mind (心 under 相) arrives (到) at an idea: you think of it.
想到.components: 想 think (相 each other + 心 heart) + 到 arrive (至 + 刂 knife)
想到.example_en: I didn't expect that he would come.

想起.mnemonic: A thought (想) rises up (起) from memory, so you recall it.
想起.components: 想 think + 起 rise (走 walk + 己 self)

得出.mnemonic: Gain (得) something that emerges (出) from sums: you reach a conclusion.
得出.components: 得 get + 出 go out (two mountains stacked)

找出.mnemonic: Hand (扌) with a weapon (戈) searches until the hidden thing comes out (出).
找出.components: 找 look for (扌 hand + 戈 spear) + 出 out

说明.mnemonic: Speak (说) so things become bright (明), meaning you explain.
说明.components: 说 say + 明 bright (日 sun + 月 moon)
说明.example_zh: 老师给我们说明了意思。
说明.example_en: The teacher explained the meaning to us.

讲话.mnemonic: Speech (讠) from the tongue (舌) lets you talk, and speech uses words (话).
讲话.components: 讲 speak (讠 speech + 井) + 话 words (讠 speech + 舌 tongue)
讲话.example_en: The principal will give a speech tomorrow.

计划.mnemonic: Words (讠) counting ten (十) steps, with a knife (刂) cutting up the work, make a plan.
计划.components: 计 count (讠 speech + 十 ten) + 划 to divide (戈 + 刂 knife)
计划.example_en: What plans do you have for your summer vacation?

怎么办.mnemonic: How (怎) to handle (办)? Ask what to do.
怎么办.components: 怎 how (乍 + 心 heart) + 么 particle + 办 to handle
怎么办.example_en: I have no money left, what should I do?

怎样.mnemonic: How (怎) is the shape (样) of the tree-like pattern? Ask the manner.
怎样.components: 怎 how + 样 manner (木 wood + 羊 sheep)

什么样.mnemonic: What (什么) kind of shape (样)? Ask about appearance.
什么样.components: 什 what + 么 particle + 样 manner/shape (木 wood + 羊 sheep)
什么样.example_en: What kind of clothes do you like?

这么.mnemonic: This (这) much, with a small 么 tag: so, like this.
这么.components: 这 this (辶 walk + 文) + 么 suffix particle
这么.example_en: It's so late and you're still not asleep?

那么.mnemonic: That (那) much, with the 么 tag: so, like that.
那么.components: 那 that (冄 + 阝 city) + 么 suffix particle

这样.mnemonic: This (这) shape (样): in this way.
这样.example_en: Is it right to do it like this?

那样.mnemonic: That (那) shape (样): in that way.
那样.example_en: He isn't that kind of person.

方法.mnemonic: A square (方) road beside water (氵) and a gone (去) problem: the way to solve it is a method.
方法.components: 方 square/direction + 法 law/way (氵 water + 去 go)
方法.example_en: What is a good method for learning Chinese?

做法.mnemonic: The act of doing (做) by the rule (法) is your way of doing it.
做法.components: 做 do (亻 person + 故) + 法 method (氵 water + 去 go)
做法.example_en: Your way of doing it is very smart.

道理.mnemonic: A road (道) cut into veins like jade (理) shows the logic behind things.
道理.components: 道 road (辶 walk + 首 head) + 理 reason (王 jade + 里 village)

但.mnemonic: A person (亻) stands at dawn (旦) and says "but" to turn the sentence.
但.example_en: I want to go, but I have no time.

可是.mnemonic: Possible (可) and right (是), yet with a turn: but.
可是.components: 可 can + 是 to be
可是.example_en: I'm very tired, but I still have to work.

不过.mnemonic: Not (不) passing (过) the point: but, however.
不过.components: 不 not + 过 pass (辶 walk + 寸)
不过.example_en: He's nice, but a bit lazy.

的话.mnemonic: Words (话) after "的" make an if clause.
的话.components: 的 particle + 话 words (讠 speech + 舌 tongue)
的话.example_zh: 明天下雨的话，我们就不去了。
的话.example_en: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.

或.mnemonic: A spear (戈) guards a mouth (口) and land (一): either this or that.
或.components: 戈 spear + 口 mouth/border + 一 ground
或.example_en: Do you want tea or coffee?

比如.mnemonic: Compare (比) it to (如) another, for example.
比如.components: 比 compare + 如 like (女 woman + 口 mouth)
比如.example_en: I like fruit, for example apples.

比如说.mnemonic: Compare (比如) and say (说) it: for example.
比如说.components: 比 compare + 如 like + 说 say
比如说.example_zh: 我喜欢运动，比如说跑步。
比如说.example_en: I like sports, for example running.

例如.mnemonic: A person (亻) lined up (列) like (如) a sample gives a for example.
例如.components: 例 example (亻 person + 列 row) + 如 like
例如.example_zh: 我会做很多菜，例如鱼和面条。
例如.example_en: I can cook many dishes, for example fish and noodles.

原因.mnemonic: A person confined inside a box (因) at the source (原): the root cause.
原因.components: 原 origin (厂 cliff + 泉 spring) + 因 cause (囗 enclosure + 大 big)
原因.example_en: What is the reason you were late?

结果.mnemonic: Silk thread (纟) tied to a fruit (果) gives the outcome.
结果.components: 结 tie (纟 silk + 吉 lucky) + 果 fruit (tree with fruit)

目的.mnemonic: An eye (目) fixed on a white (白) target with a drop (丶) marks the aim.
目的.components: 目 eye + 的 target (白 white + 勺 spoon)
目的.example_zh: 我来这里的目的是学习。
目的.example_en: My purpose in coming here is to study.

好处.mnemonic: A good (好) place (处) holds benefits.
好处.components: 好 good + 处 place (夂 + 卜)
好处.example_en: Exercising more is good for your body.

坏处.mnemonic: Soil (土) crumbling away makes things bad, and the place (处) it happens shows the harm.
坏处.components: 坏 bad (土 earth + 不 not) + 处 place
坏处.example_en: Playing on your phone too long is harmful.

条件.mnemonic: A person (亻) with a wooden strip (条) lists the terms or conditions.
条件.components: 条 strip (夂 + 木 wood) + 件 item (亻 person + 牛 ox)
条件.example_en: The conditions of this job are very good.

例子.mnemonic: A sample (例) child (子) points to an example.
例子.components: 例 example (亻 person + 列 row) + 子 child/suffix

特点.mnemonic: A special ox (牛 in 特) with a dot (点) marks a feature.
特点.components: 特 special (牜 ox + 寺 temple) + 点 dot (占 + 灬 fire)
特点.example_zh: 这个城市的特点是什么？
特点.example_en: What is the characteristic of this city?

重点.mnemonic: Heavy (重) dot (点) on the page marks the main point.

方面.mnemonic: The square (方) side and the face (面): an aspect.
方面.example_en: He works hard in terms of studying.

好事.mnemonic: A good (好) matter (事): a good thing.
好事.example_en: He has done many good deeds.

越来越.mnemonic: Run beyond (越) and come (来) beyond again: increasingly more.
越来越.components: 越 exceed (走 walk + 戉) + 来 come + 越 exceed
越来越.example_en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

不如.mnemonic: Not (不) like (如): not as good as.
不如.components: 不 not + 如 like (女 woman + 口 mouth)
不如.example_en: Walking is not as fast as riding a bike.

同样.components: 同 same (冂 + 一 + 口) + 样 manner

相同.mnemonic: Eye and tree (相) combine with same (同): identical.
相同.components: 相 mutual (木 tree + 目 eye) + 同 same

等于.mnemonic: Wait (等) at the same level as (于): equals.
等于.components: 等 wait/equal (⺮ bamboo + 寺) + 于 at

超过.mnemonic: Run (召 call with 走) past (过) the limit: surpass.
超过.components: 超 exceed (走 walk + 召 call) + 过 pass (辶 walk + 寸)

以上.mnemonic: Using (以) the top (上) as boundary: above.
以上.components: 以 by means of + 上 up
以上.example_en: Those aged eighteen and above may enter.

以下.mnemonic: Using (以) the bottom (下) as boundary: below.
以下.components: 以 by means of + 下 down
以下.example_zh: 五岁以下的孩子不用买票。
以下.example_en: Children under five need no ticket.

以外.mnemonic: Using (以) the outside (外) as boundary: beyond.
以外.components: 以 by means of + 外 outside (夕 evening + 卜)
以外.example_zh: 除了他以外，大家都来了。

其中.example_zh: 我有三个朋友，其中两个是老师。
其中.example_en: I have three friends, two of whom are teachers.

合适.mnemonic: Joining (合) a road (辶 in 适) fits: suitable.
合适.components: 合 fit + 适 suitable (辶 walk + 舌)
合适.example_en: This piece of clothing fits well.

不错.mnemonic: Not (不) a mistake (错 gold-like 钅): not bad.
不错.components: 不 not + 错 wrong (钅 metal + 昔)

难看.mnemonic: Hard (难) to look at (看): ugly.
难看.components: 难 hard (又 + 隹 bird) + 看 look (手 hand over 目 eye)

难听.mnemonic: Hard (难) to listen to (听): unpleasant to hear.

脏.mnemonic: A body part (月 flesh) with a hidden (庄) smear: dirty.

低.mnemonic: A person (亻) bent low at the root (氐): low.
低.example_en: The tables here are too low.

轻.mnemonic: A cart (车) with a stream (巠) that slides easily: light.

平.mnemonic: A flat line across with a balance of dots: level and flat.
平.components: Single pictograph: flat level surface with two side marks
平.example_en: The road is flat and comfortable to walk on.

高级.mnemonic: Tall (高) steps (级) of rank: advanced.
高级.components: 高 tall + 级 level (纟 silk + 及 reach)
高级.example_en: He is taking an advanced Chinese class.

有意思.components: 有 have + 意 meaning + 思 think

假.mnemonic: A person (亻) holding something borrowed (叚): fake.

正确.mnemonic: Right (正) and solid (确 with stone 石): correct.
正确.components: 正 correct + 确 certain (石 stone + 角)

准确.components: 准 accurate (冫 ice + 隹 bird) + 确 certain
准确.example_en: What he said is very accurate.

实际.mnemonic: Solid (实) boundary (际 hill 阝): actual.
实际.components: 实 real (宀 roof + 头) + 际 border (阝 hill + 示)
实际.example_en: The actual situation is not like this.

完全.mnemonic: Whole (完 under roof) and complete (全): completely.
完全.components: 完 finish (宀 roof + 元) + 全 whole (人 + 王)

正好.mnemonic: Right (正) and good (好): just right.
正好.example_en: You came just at the right time.

正是.components: 正 right + 是 to be
正是.example_en: This is exactly what I wanted.

直接.mnemonic: Straight (直) contact (接 with hand 扌): direct.
直接.components: 直 straight + 接 connect (扌 hand + 妾)

公平.example_en: It's not fair to do it this way.

平等.mnemonic: Level (平) and equal rank (等): equality.
平等.example_en: Men and women should be equal.

自由.mnemonic: From self (自 nose) and from a source (由): freedom.

顺利.mnemonic: Following the flow (顺 with page 页) and sharp (利 knife 刂): smooth.
顺利.components: 顺 smooth (川 river + 页 page) + 利 sharp (禾 grain + 刂 knife)

变.mnemonic: Silk threads (亦 with 又) turn: change.

变成.mnemonic: Change (变) into being complete (成): turn into.

成.mnemonic: A spear (戈) completes (丁) a task: become.

成为.mnemonic: Become (成) what you act as (为): become.
成为.example_en: I want to become a doctor.

改.mnemonic: Oneself (己) hit with a tap (攵): correct and change.

实现.components: 实 real + 现 appear (王 jade + 见 see)

做到.mnemonic: Do (做) and arrive (到): manage to do.

取得.components: 取 take (耳 ear + 又 hand) + 得 get

组成.mnemonic: Silk thread (纟) joined into a whole (成): form.
组成.components: 组 group (纟 silk + 且) + 成 become
组成.example_en: This team is made up of ten people.

忽然.mnemonic: A heart (心) in a moment (勿) and fire (然): suddenly.
忽然.components: 忽 sudden (勿 + 心 heart) + 然 so (灬 fire)

活动.mnemonic: Water (氵) live (活) and move (动): an activity.
活动.components: 活 live (氵 water + 舌) + 动 move (云 + 力 power)

参观.mnemonic: Join (参) and view (观) a place: visit.
参观.components: 参 join + 观 view (又 + 见 see)
参观.example_en: We are going to visit the museum.

报名.mnemonic: Report (报) your name (名): sign up.
报名.components: 报 report + 名 name (夕 evening + 口 mouth)
报名.example_en: I want to sign up for the competition.

举行.mnemonic: Raise (举) and carry on (行): hold an event.
举行.example_en: The match will be held tomorrow.

进行.mnemonic: Enter (进) and proceed (行): carry out.
进行.components: 进 enter (辶 walk + 井) + 行 do

晚会.components: 晚 evening (日 sun + 免) + 会 meet

音乐会.components: 音 sound + 乐 music + 会 gathering

过年.mnemonic: Pass (过) the year (年): celebrate New Year.
过年.example_en: I go home at New Year.

实习.example_en: He is interning at a company.

干活儿.mnemonic: Dry (干) work (活) child (儿): do labour.
干活儿.components: 干 do + 活 work + 儿 suffix

有空儿.components: 有 have + 空 empty (穴 cave + 工) + 儿 suffix

科学.mnemonic: Grain (科 with 禾) and learn (学): science.
科学.components: 科 branch (禾 grain + 斗) + 学 study

流行.mnemonic: Water flows (流) and walks (行): popular.
流行.components: 流 flow (氵 water + 𠫓) + 行 go
流行.example_en: This kind of clothing is popular.

送到.components: 送 send (辶 walk) + 到 arrive
送到.example_en: Please deliver the book to my home.

送给.mnemonic: Send (送) and give (给): give as a gift.
送给.components: 送 send + 给 give (纟 silk + 合)

交.mnemonic: A man with crossed legs: cross over, hand over.
交.components: Pictograph of crossed legs (亠 + 乂)

交给.mnemonic: Hand over (交) and give (给): hand to.
交给.components: 交 hand over + 给 give
交给.example_en: Hand the money to the teacher.

收.mnemonic: A tap (攵) to gather things: receive.

接到.mnemonic: Hand (扌) joins (接) and arrives (到): receive.
接到.example_en: I got a phone call from him.

受到.example_en: He was praised by the teacher.

拿出.mnemonic: Hand (扌) takes (拿) and exits (出): take out.
拿出.components: 拿 take (合 + 手 hand) + 出 out

取.mnemonic: An ear (耳) held in a hand (又): take.
取.example_en: Please go to the front desk to get the key.

带来.example_en: He brought a lot of fruit.

拉.example_en: Please pull the door, don't push.

推.mnemonic: Hand (扌) pushing a bird (隹): push.

提.example_en: He is carrying a big bag.

放下.components: 放 place (方 + 攵) + 下 down

掉.mnemonic: Hand (扌) lets a tall (卓) thing fall: drop.

倒.mnemonic: A person (亻) falls to pour (到): pour.
倒.example_en: Please pour me a glass of water.

碰.mnemonic: Stone (石) meets a pair (並): bump.

装.mnemonic: Clothing (衣) with a strip (壮): pack.
装.example_en: He packed clothes into the bag.

弄.mnemonic: Two hands (廾) holding jade (王): handle.
弄.components: 王 jade + 廾 two hands

办.mnemonic: A strength (力) with two dots: handle.
办.example_en: This matter is easy to handle.

使用.components: 使 make (亻 person + 吏) + 用 use

查.mnemonic: Wood (木) with a sun (日): check.

算.mnemonic: Bamboo (⺮) eyes (目) and hands (廾): calculate.
算.components: ⺮ bamboo + 目 eye + 廾 hands

进入.mnemonic: Enter (进) and come in (入): go into.

走开.example_en: Please go away, don't block the road.

过来.mnemonic: Pass (过) and come (来): come over.
过来.example_en: Come over here for a moment.

通过.mnemonic: Connect (通) pass (过): by means of.

通.mnemonic: A road (辶) with a way (甬): go through.

停.mnemonic: A person (亻) at a pavilion (亭): stop.
停.example_en: The car stopped at the door.

排.mnemonic: Hand (扌) with a row (非): line up.
